items.titleEn: Bringing the Bloodmobile to Emirates Stadium
items.summaryEn: Rizzy Akanji explains the importance of sickle cell awareness
bodyEn: In Black History Month two years ago, the H.E.R.O Network welcomed sickle cell activist and campaigner Rizzy Akanji to Highbury House to deliver a talk on sickle cell, spreading awareness around the condition and the importance of blood donation in treatment.
Fisayo Roberts has proudly continued this work, leading to the launch of the Bloodmobile at Emirates Stadium.

From the moment we started this conversation, we began a very personal journey that so many people have been invested in. Sickle cell disproportionately affects those of Black heritage, and for some colleagues at the club, including myself, there are very real stories of how the condition has affected our lives.

What began as a session to raise awareness quickly became a very special project that brought the H.E.R.O Network together and prompted us to ask ourselves how we could take sickle cell awareness to a bigger scale.
For the past two years we've worked with NHS Blood and Transplant, Islington Council and local community stakeholders to bring a mobile blood donation unit on site at Emirates Stadium.
Last week, that idea became a reality, as we cut the ribbon alongside the Mayor of Islington and unveiled the Bloodmobile.

We have longstanding and deep-rooted connections with London's Black communities, and by launching of the bloodmobile at home at Emirates Stadium in one of the capital's most diverse boroughs, we're providing an important opportunity to build on those relationships, raise awareness and encourage more people to become lifesaving blood donors.

This journey has drawn on the emotion and hard work of so many throughout the club, and I couldn't be prouder of the progress the H.E.R.O Network has made and the initiative we've taken to make positive change throughout our community.

The Bloodmobile will be coming back to Emirates Stadium on 20 November, with a further three visits throughout the rest of the season. If you'd like to donate blood at one of those dates you can find more information here.

Our film above tells the story in full detail and elaborates on the journey we've been on together. On behalf of the H.E.R.O Network, I'd like to thank everyone who’s played a part in bringing the Bloodmobile to life and to the club for the support throughout.

items.titleZh: 将献血车开进酋长球场
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳引入移动献血车，推广镰状细胞贫血症防治意识。
bodyZh: 在两年前的黑人历史月期间，H.E.R.O网络迎来了镰状细胞贫血症活动家兼宣传员Rizzy Akanji做客海布里大厦，就镰状细胞贫血症发表了演讲，普及了这种疾病的相关知识以及献血在治疗中的重要性。
Fisayo Roberts自豪地延续了这项工作，促成了酋长球场移动献血车的启动。
从我们开始这次对话的那一刻起，我们就开启了一段非常个人的旅程，许多人都投入其中。镰状细胞贫血症对黑人血统的人群影响尤为严重，对于包括我在内的俱乐部的一些同事来说，这种疾病如何影响我们生活的真实故事历历在目。
最初旨在提高意识的交流会，很快变成了一个非常特殊的项目，将H.E.R.O网络凝聚在了一起，并促使我们思考如何将镰状细胞贫血症的宣传规模扩大。
在过去的两年里，我们与英国国民保健制度血液与移植局、伊斯灵顿议会以及当地社区利益相关者合作，将移动献血车引入了酋长球场。
上周，这一设想变成了现实，我们与伊斯灵顿市长一同剪彩，并正式推出了移动献血车。
我们与伦敦的黑人社区有着长期且深厚的联系，通过在首都最多元化的行政区之一、我们的主场酋长球场启动移动献血车，我们提供了一个重要的机会，以巩固这些关系、提高意识并鼓励更多人成为挽救生命的献血者。
这段旅程凝聚了俱乐部上下许多人的情感与辛勤付出，对于H.E.R.O网络所取得的进展以及我们为给整个社区带来积极改变所采取的主动行动，我感到无比自豪。
移动献血车将于11月20日重返酋长球场，并在本赛季余下时间里再进行三次访问。如果您想在这些日期的其中一天捐献血液，可以在此查找更多信息。
我们上方的短片详细讲述了整个故事，并阐述了我们共同经历的历程。我谨代表H.E.R.O网络，向所有为移动献血车的诞生出一份力的人以及俱乐部自始至终的支持表示感谢。

items.titleEn: U18s preview: Arsenal v Brentford
items.summaryEn: Our young Gunners aim to make it seven wins on the spin against debutant Bees
bodyEn: Our young Gunners host Brentford in the U18 Premier League South on Saturday, October 31, aiming to extend their winning run to seven games.
Kick-off at the Sobha Realty Training Ground is scheduled for 10.30am (UK time).
Our academy side struck three times in the opening 17 minutes away at Aston Villa last week, continuing their fine form to sit fourth on 16 points.
A flash of ruthlessness saw Teshaun Murisa, Axel Donczew and Mylo Bernard wrap up the points early on, despite the West Midlands side pulling one back before the break.
THE OPPOSITION
The Bees are competing in the league for the first time this season after being awarded Category One status and have made a solid start to their debut campaign.
They have recorded four wins and four defeats in their opening eight games, with their attacking threat offset by goals conceded.

With 29 goals in their opening eight games, the west London side offer significant firepower, as shown in last weekend's 5-4 defeat to Fulham, but defensive frailties have them sat eighth on 11 points.
Our capital compatriots are also competing in the U18 Premier League Cup, but after two defeats to Burnley and Manchester City, they look set to bow out of Group D.
The U18 PL South clash will mark our first-ever meeting with Brentford at this level.
HOW TO FOLLOW
The action gets underway from 10.30am (UK), with live updates available on our Academy X account and a full match report shortly after the final whistle.
Post-match, don't miss exclusive interviews with one of our academy coaches and young Gunners, as well as highlights of all the key action on The Arsenal app and Arsenal.com.

items.titleZh: U18前瞻：阿森纳对阵布伦特福德
items.summaryZh: 小阿森纳将力争对阵新军布伦特福德取得七连胜。
bodyZh: 10月31日星期六，我们的年轻枪手将在U18英超南部联赛中主场迎战布伦特福德，力争将连胜纪录扩大到七场。
索巴地产训练基地的开球时间定于英国时间上午10点30分。
上周在客场对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛中，我们的青训梯队在开场17分钟内连入三球，延续了他们的良好状态，目前以16分排名第四。
尽管西米德兰兹球队在半场结束前扳回一城，但凭借特沙恩·穆里萨（Teshaun Murisa）、阿克塞尔·东切夫（Axel Donczew）和迈洛·伯纳德（Mylo Bernard）的犀利进攻，我们在开局阶段就锁定胜局。
对手情况
在获得一级青训资格后，布伦特福德本赛季首次参加该级别联赛，并在他们的处子赛季中取得了稳健的开局。
他们在前八场比赛中取得了四场胜利和四场失利，其进攻威胁被失球数所抵消。
前八场比赛打入29球，这家西伦敦球会展现出了强大的火力，正如上周末5-4负于富勒姆的比赛所示，但防守上的软肋让他们以11分排名第八。
我们的这支同城对手还参加了U18英超杯，但在先后输给伯恩利和曼城后，他们看起来将从D组出局。
这场U18英超南部联赛将是我们在这个级别上与布伦特福德的首次交锋。
如何关注比赛
比赛将于英国时间上午10点30分开始，您可以通过我们的青训X账号获取实时战报，终场哨响后不久将发布完整的比赛报告。
赛后，请不要错过在阿森纳官方App和Arsenal.com上观看的一位青训教练和年轻枪手的独家采访，以及所有精彩画面的集锦。

items.titleEn: Premier League: 10 things to look out for this weekend
items.summaryEn: Bruno Fernandes owes Manchester United a performance, Mathys Tel has arrived at Spurs and Liverpool are improvingPremier League top scorersMichael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes held clear-the-air talks this week. Fernandes was an unused substitute against Bournemouth after criticising Carrick’s tactics during the Champions League defeat at Como but it seems the situation has been resolved – for now. Dropping Fernandes did not do United any good against Bournemouth, who ran riot at Old Trafford, and the captain is expected to return to the starting lineup for the trip to Chelsea. If that happens, he owes Carrick a performance. Fernandes has been poor this season and it is time he did his talking on the pitch. bodyEn: Michael Carrick and Bruno Fernandes held clear-the-air talks this week. Fernandes was an unused substitute against Bournemouth after criticising Carrick’s tactics during the Champions League defeat at Como but it seems the situation has been resolved – for now. Dropping Fernandes did not do United any good against Bournemouth, who ran riot at Old Trafford, and the captain is expected to return to the starting lineup for the trip to Chelsea. If that happens, he owes Carrick a performance. Fernandes has been poor this season and it is time he did his talking on the pitch. Jacob Steinberg
Chelsea v Manchester United, Saturday 12.30pm (all times GMT)

Since Manchester City were found guilty of serially breaching Premier League financial rules, Enzo Maresca’s team have won four games (including Wednesday’s Carabao Cup shootout victory over Brighton) and lost two. Saturday’s 2-1 reverse at Aston Villa was their first Premier League defeat and should another follow in their rematch with the Seagulls, the manager may start to fear the guilty verdict and possible sanctions (demotion to the Championship, for example) becoming a distraction to his players. There is a precedent for City initially responding well to adversity, before it then affected results. After Rodri sustained a serious knee injury against Arsenal in September 2024, Pep Guardiola’s team went undefeated in seven matches, winning six. But then the wheels clattered off, with one victory and 10 defeats in the next 13. Jamie Jackson
Manchester City v Brighton, Saturday 3pm

The last time north-east opposition visited the CBS Arena, Frank Lampard’s side had no trouble finding the net, but their four goals against Newcastle on 12 October make up two-thirds of their league total for the season. Perhaps the most creative player at the club has spent most of this campaign watching from the bench. Gustavo Hamer, who created 12 goals for his Sheffield United teammates in the Championship last season, has asked to play for the under-21s to get his minutes up. “Myself and the staff have been really, really impressed by his approach, his training, his ethic,” Lampard said before Hamer came on as an 86th-minute substitute in last weekend’s defeat by Fulham. Will he get more than four minutes off the bench against the only team beneath Coventry in the table? Billy Munday
Coventry v Sunderland, Saturday 3pm

Beating Milan and then Manchester United made for a halcyon week in Bournemouth’s history. Winning at Old Trafford and defeating Aston Villa in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday all followed Marco Rose’s first Premier League win, against Sunderland on 18 October, which came as a great relief. The project is back on course. Eli Junior Kroupi, a late substitute last Sunday, has returned to the squad. In the Frenchman’s absence Evanilson has been on his best run of form since joining the club. He has four goals from five matches, and a tight-angled finish to make it 3-0 at United belied his reputation as a player who could score more. The Brazilian is a capable line leader, with Kroupi able to work the space his partner’s tireless running creates. When Sturm Graz were defeated in the Europa League, Evanilson served as support striker for the raw Álvaro Rodríguez. There is little starry about a club-record signing whose work ethic has been important to Rose’s early weeks in charge. John Brewin
Bournemouth v Leeds, Saturday 3pm

Brentford’s early-season charge has slowed, with no wins from their last three and a disappointing draw at Hull last week – although only Liverpool have beaten Keith Andrews’ team this season in the Premier League. A 1-1 draw at Ipswich last Friday heightened frustrations at Nottingham Forest, with Liam Delap’s scoring touch continuing to desert him and an unmarked Murillo missing a free header the best of a host of unconverted chances. The better opportunities tended to arrive from the flanks, with Daniel Muñoz overlapping from wingback as the supplier for Neco Williams’ goal. After a decent start to the season for Morgan Gibbs-White in terms of chance creation, he was crowded out by Ipswich’s packed midfield. Oliver Glasner’s formation, founded on a defensive trio, seeks to bring the best from playmakers and ball-players. It brought results from Eberechi Eze and Adam Wharton at Crystal Palace but Gibbs-White and Forest are yet to prosper. Better finishing would certainly help a team stuck in the bottom three. JB
Brentford v Nottingham Forest, Saturday 3pm

Two promoted teams and two positive managers meet at the MKM Stadium on Saturday. “There will be ups and downs, this is normal,” said Hull’s Sergej Jakirovic last week. “We showed already that we can compete.” Ipswich’s Gary O’Neil is similarly enthusiastic. “They’re an incredible group,” he said of his players this week. “We’re not carrying anybody in that, there’s no one getting dragged along by this group.” Both teams kick off in mid-table, though with the awareness of the importance of defeating opponents with similar ambitions. While other Championship graduates have been too readily accepting of their fate, both have grasped the nettle and shown off their survival instincts. Manchester City’s potential punishment could create an opportunity, leaving just two relegation spots to avoid. Hull’s initial hot streak has cooled, though last week’s draw with Brentford was useful. Against Forest, Ipswich made up for their lack of fluidity by showing the staying power to claim a point. JB

Hull v Ipswich, Saturday 3pm

Despite landing in the Premier League in January last year, Mathys Tel’s goal against Chelsea felt like an arrival of sorts. The 21-year-old was highly rated as a youngster at Bayern Munich but has found the net just seven times in 50 league games since joining Spurs, initially on loan. Against Chelsea he picked the ball up in his own half and drove forwards 40 yards before finding the bottom corner from the edge of the box. Spurs fans will want more from Tel who, unlike many of his teammates, is rarely injured. “I think I can still do better,” he said after the 2-0 win at Chelsea that made it two on the spin for Spurs. “I can always do better. I need to work, work, work, work.” Crystal Palace come off the back of victory at Fulham in the Carabao Cup – the head coach, Pierre Sage, has been backed by the board after a tricky spell in the league. BM
Tottenham v Crystal Palace, Saturday 5.30pm

Álvaro Arbeloa is at last getting somewhere with Fulham. After going without a win in his first six league matches, the Spaniard has collected six points against Hull and Coventry. Goals remain in short supply, though, and the form of the £40m striker Gonzalo García – seven games without scoring – is concerning. Arbeloa’s past relationship with García at Real Madrid is not proving as beneficial as Unai Emery’s knowledge of Nicolas Jackson’s game. That pair worked together at Villarreal, where Emery gave Jackson his La Liga debut. “Unai taught me everything about football,” Jackson said on signing from Chelsea in the summer. With four goals in five Premier League games, including a double against Manchester City last Saturday, Jackson is one of the form strikers in the country. “He was shooting a lot of balls over the crossbar,” Emery said. “Now he’s getting better.” BM
Aston Villa v Fulham, Saturday 8pm

“Let’s try to finish this four-in-a-row in the best way,” said Andoni Iraola on Wednesday as thoughts turned from the Carabao Cup penalty shootout win over Chelsea to Arsenal’s impending visit to Anfield. Three consecutive home wins in different competitions, and in quick succession, have helped build momentum at Liverpool, although seven wins from the last eight (including Chelsea) shows the process had already begun. Iraola has handled his first intensive run of Champions League, Premier League and Carabao Cup fixtures expertly, rotating in every game while continuing to produce results. Noticeably, there has been no drop-off in Liverpool’s physical intensity either. The manner of Arsenal’s title triumph last season – and the general shift towards more aggressive, urgent football in the Premier League – were factors in Liverpool’s decision to change head coaches in the summer, and the results are paying off quickly. Iraola will be facing questions about a title challenge should four-in-a-row finish as he hopes on Sunday. Andy Hunter
Liverpool v Arsenal, Sunday 4.30pm

David Moyes described it as “out of this world”, Alan Shearer talked about a world-class intervention, and Jordan Pickford agreed it ranked as “up there with my very best”. Rewind to March and Everton are beating Newcastle 3-2 on Tyneside when, in the 94th minute, Sandro Tonali unleashes a vicious and technically perfect volley. To the astonishment of everyone inside St James’ Park, Everton’s goalkeeper throws out his right hand and tips the ball over the crossbar. Pickford’s teammate Jarrad Branthwaite said it was “the best save I’ve ever seen” and Moyes can only hope his England goalkeeper proves in similarly defiant mood at a time when his international place is under a little pressure from the Leeds goalkeeper, James Trafford. Not that Pickford will lack inspiration; the lifelong Sunderland fan always enjoys frustrating Newcastle, as he did again in Thursday’s Carabao Cup victory. Matthias Jaissle’s team, and their midfield, are still adapting to life after Tonali and face a testing rematch at St James’ Park on Monday. Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Everton, Monday 8pm

items.titleZh: 英超：本周末看点前瞻
items.summaryZh: 英超本周末迎来多场焦点战，阿森纳将客场挑战利物浦，多支球队面临考验。
bodyZh: 迈克尔·卡里克和布鲁诺·费尔南德斯本周进行了坦诚交流。在因批评卡里克在欧冠负于科莫时的战术而被排除在对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛大名单之外后，费尔南德斯本场没有出场，但情况似乎暂时得到了解决。对阵伯恩茅斯时曼联表现不佳，队长预计将在客场对阵切尔西时重回首发。如果是这样，他需要用表现来回报卡里克。本赛季费尔南德斯表现平平，是时候在球场上用表现说话了。雅各ブ·斯坦伯格
切尔西对阵曼联，周六下午12:30（所有时间均为格林尼治标准时间）

自从曼城被裁定多次违反英超财务规则以来，恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队赢得了四场比赛（包括周三在联赛杯点球大战中击败布赖顿），输了两场。周六客场1-2不敌阿斯顿维拉是他们在英超的首场失利，如果在与海鸥军团的重赛中再次失利，这位主帅可能会开始担心有罪判决和可能的制裁（例如降级到英冠）会分散球员的注意力。此前曼城在面对逆境时曾有过良好反应，然后才影响到结果。在罗德里于2024年9月对阵阿森纳时膝盖严重受伤后，瓜迪奥拉的球队在七场比赛中保持不败，赢了六场。但随后情况急转直下，在接下来的13场比赛中仅赢一场却输了10场。杰米·杰克逊
曼城对阵布赖顿，周六下午3点

上一次东北部对手造访CBS竞技场时，兰帕德的球队毫无困难地取得了进球，但他们在10月12日对阵纽卡斯尔打进的四球占了他们本赛季联赛总进球的三分之二。也许俱乐部最具创造力的球员本赛季大部分时间都在替补席上度过。古斯塔沃·哈默上赛季在英冠为谢菲尔德联队的队友创造了12个进球，他要求参加U21的比赛以增加出场时间。“我和教练组对他的态度、训练和职业道德印象非常深刻，”兰帕德在哈默作为第86分钟替补登场负于富勒姆的比赛前说道。面对积分榜上仅排在考文垂身后的球队，他能得到超过四分钟的替补出场时间吗？比利·蒙代
考文垂对阵桑德兰，周六下午3点

击败米兰随后击败曼联，构成了伯恩茅斯历史上幸福的一周。在马尔科·罗斯迎来执教伯恩茅斯后的首场英超胜利（10月18日击败桑德兰）后，球队在老特拉福德赢球，并在周三的联赛杯中击败了阿斯顿维拉，这让人感到非常欣慰。球队的计划重回正轨。上周日晚些时候替补登场的埃利·儒尼奥尔·克鲁皮已重返阵容。在法国人缺阵期间，埃瓦尼尔森迎来了加盟球队以来最好的状态。他在五场比赛中攻入四球，对阵曼联时小角度破门将比分改写为3-0，这打破了他只会打进简单进球的印象。这位巴西人是一名出色的锋线支柱，而克鲁皮则能够利用搭档不懈奔跑创造出的空间。当在欧联杯中击败格拉茨风暴时，埃瓦尼尔森担任了年轻的阿尔瓦罗·罗德里格斯的影子前锋。对于一个俱乐部标王来说，他的职业道德对罗斯上任初期的工作至关重要，这并没有什么星味。约翰·布鲁因
伯恩茅斯对阵利兹联，周六下午3点

布伦特福德本赛季初期的强劲势头有所放缓，最近三场比赛未尝胜绩，上周在赫尔城只收获一场令人失望的平局——尽管本赛季在英超中只有利物浦击败过基思·安德鲁斯的球队。上周五在伊普斯维奇收获1-1的平局加剧了诺丁汉森林的沮丧情绪，利亚姆·德拉普的进球感觉继续消失，穆里略在一记无人防守的头球攻门中错失良机，这是众多未能转化为进球的机会中最好的一次。更好的机会往往来自边路，丹尼尔·穆尼奥斯作为边翼卫前插为内科·威廉姆斯的进球提供了助攻。在摩根·吉布斯-怀特本赛季初期的创造机会方面表现尚可之后，他被伊普斯维奇密集的防守中场挤压。奥利弗·格拉斯纳的阵型以三后卫为基础，旨在发挥进攻组织者和传球手的最佳水平。它在水晶宫为埃泽和亚当·沃顿带来了成果，但吉布斯-怀特和森林队尚未从中受益。更好的终结能力肯定会帮助这支深陷降级区的球队。JB
布伦特福德对阵诺丁汉森林，周六下午3点

两支升班马和两位积极的主帅周六将在MKM球场相遇。“会有起伏，这是正常的，”赫尔城的谢尔盖·雅科维奇上周表示。“我们已经证明了我们可以竞争。”伊普斯维奇的加里·奥尼尔同样充满热情。“他们是一个不可思议的群体，”他本周谈到自己的球员时说道。“我们没有带着任何人，这个群体里没有人是在被拖后腿。”两支球队开局都处于中游，但也意识到击败有相似雄心的对手的重要性。虽然其他英冠升班马过早地接受了他们的命运，但这两支球队都迎难而上，展现出了他们的保级本能。曼城潜在的惩罚可能会创造机会，只剩下两个降级名额需要避免。赫尔城最初的连胜势头已经冷却，不过上周与布伦特福德的平局很有用。面对森林队，伊普斯维奇通过展现出顽强的斗志来争取积分，弥补了他们流畅性的不足。JB

尽管去年1月才登陆英超，但马蒂斯·特尔对阵切尔西的进球感觉像是某种意义上的闪耀登场。这位21岁的球员在拜仁慕尼黑效力时曾被寄予厚望，但自加盟热刺（最初为租借）以来，他在50场联赛中仅攻入7球。对阵切尔西时，他在自己半场拿球，带球推进40码，随后在禁区边缘劲射远角破门。热刺球迷希望特尔能有更多表现，与他的许多队友不同，他很少受伤。“我认为我还能做得更好，”他在热刺2-0击败切尔西取得两连胜后说道。“我总是可以做得更好。我需要努力、努力、努力、努力。”水晶宫在联赛杯击败富勒姆后重整旗鼓——在经历了一段艰难的联赛期后，主教练皮埃尔·萨奇得到了董事会的大力支持。BM
热刺对阵水晶宫，周六下午5:30

阿尔瓦罗·阿韦罗亚终于在富勒姆取得了一些进展。在执教前六场联赛一场未胜之后，这位西班牙人在赫尔城和考文垂身上拿到了六分。然而，进球依然匮乏，身价4000万英镑的前锋贡萨洛·加西亚连续七场比赛没有进球的现状令人担忧。阿韦罗亚过去在皇家马德里与加西亚的关系，并不像埃梅里对尼古拉斯·杰克逊比赛风格的了解那样带来益处。这对组合曾在比利亚雷亚尔共事，当时埃梅里给了杰克逊西甲首秀的机会。“埃梅里教会了我关于足球的一切，”杰克逊在夏天从切尔西转会时说道。凭借在五场英超比赛中的四粒进球，包括上周六对阵曼城时的梅开二度，杰克逊成为了国内状态最好的前锋之一。“他之前有很多球都射飞了，”埃梅里说道。“现在他正在变好。”BM

“让我们以最好的方式结束这四连胜，”安多尼·伊劳拉周三在思绪从联赛杯点球大战击败切尔西转移到阿森纳即将到来的安菲尔德之行时说道。在不同赛事中连续三场主场胜利且节奏紧凑，帮助利物浦建立起了势头，尽管过去八场赢下七场（包括切尔西）表明这一进程早已开始。伊劳拉巧妙地应对了他在欧冠、英超和联赛杯中的第一波密集赛程，在每场比赛中进行轮换的同时继续取得成绩。值得注意的是，利物浦的身体强度也没有下降。上赛季阿森纳夺冠的方式——以及英超联赛中朝着更具侵略性、更紧凑的足球转变的总体趋势——是利物浦在夏天决定更换主教练的因素，而这些结果正在迅速见效。如果周日四连胜如他所愿结束，伊劳拉将面临关于争冠的提问。安迪·亨特

大卫·莫耶斯将其形容为“不可思议”，阿兰·希勒谈到了一次世界级的高接低档，而乔丹·皮克福德则同意这“算得上我职业生涯的最佳扑救之一”。回溯到今年3月，埃弗顿在泰恩赛德以3-2击败纽卡斯尔，当时在第94分钟，桑德罗·托纳利轰出了一记凶狠且技术完美的凌空抽射。令圣詹姆斯公园球场内的所有人惊叹的是，埃弗顿门将伸出右手将球托出横梁。皮克福德的队友贾拉德·布兰思韦特表示，这是他“见过的最精彩的扑救”，莫耶斯只能希望他的英格兰国门在面临来自利兹联门将詹姆斯·特拉福德的一点国家队位置压力时，能表现出同样坚定的态度。皮克福德绝不会缺乏动力；这位终身桑德兰球迷总是喜欢让纽卡斯尔感到沮丧，正如他在周四的联赛杯胜利中所做的那样。马蒂亚斯·杰斯le的球队及其克敌制胜的中场仍在适应没有托纳利的生活，周一将在圣詹姆斯公园迎来一场考验重重的重赛。路易丝·泰勒

items.titleEn: Max Dowman to miss three games after Arsenal’s red card appeal rejected
items.summaryEn: Teenager was sent off for lashing out in Fleetwood defeatClub’s claims over card and ban were both dismissedArsenal’s appeal against Max Dowman’s red card in their Carabao Cup defeat at Fleetwood and the three-match suspension imposed has been rejected by an independent commission.The 16-year-old Dowman was sent off for a kick out at Harrison Neal following a bruising tackle in the 85th minute of the game, which Fleetwood won on penalties after a 1-1 draw. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Arsenal’s appeal against Max Dowman’s red card in their Carabao Cup defeat at Fleetwood and the three-match suspension imposed has been rejected by an independent commission.
The 16-year-old Dowman was sent off for a kick out at Harrison Neal following a bruising tackle in the 85th minute of the game, which Fleetwood won on penalties after a 1-1 draw.

Arsenal subsequently lodged an appeal, but the Football Association confirmed on Thursday an independent commission had dismissed claims of both wrongful dismissal and excessive punishment for Dowman.
As a result, Dowman will be suspended for Sunday’s Premier League trip to Liverpool as well as their home game with Hull and trip to Newcastle either side of the international break.
The FA said the written reasons for the commission’s decision to dismiss the claims would be published in due course.

The Arsenal manager, Mikel Arteta, said after Tuesday’s match he had not spoken to Dowman about his dismissal, but added: “When we prepared the context of the match, we were very clear on the things to respect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate, it was very clear.”

After Fleetwood’s keeper, Jay Lynch, saved Bruno Guimarães’ penalty, 19-year-old defender Conor Haughey stepped up to fire the hosts into the quarter-finals with one of the biggest upsets in the competition’s history. Fleetwood will host another Premier League side, Everton, in the last eight.
Arsenal fell behind to Aaron Loupalo-Bi’s 21st-minute strike in a disjointed first-half performance after Arteta made nine changes.
The captain, Martin Ødegaard, came on at half-time and Viktor Gyökeres quickly levelled, but Dowman was dismissed before Lynch starred in the shootout to secure a memorable victory.

items.titleZh: 马克·多曼红牌上诉被驳回，将缺席三场比赛
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳小将马克·多曼的红牌上诉被独立委员会驳回，他将被禁赛三场。
bodyZh: 阿森纳针对马克·多曼在联赛杯对阵弗利特伍德比赛中染红及随之而来的三场禁赛提起上诉，已被独立委员会驳回。
这名16岁球员在比赛进行到第85分钟时，因在一次激烈拼抢后踢向哈里森·尼尔而被罚下。双方在常规时间战成1-1平，随后弗利特伍德通过点球大战取胜。
阿森纳随后提出了上诉，但英足总于周四确认，独立委员会驳回了关于对多曼不当罚下和过度惩罚的主张。
因此，多曼将错过周日英超客场对阵利物浦的比赛，以及国际比赛日前后主场对阵赫尔城和客场对阵纽卡斯尔的比赛。
英足总表示，委员会驳回这些主张的书面理由将在适时公布。
阿森纳主帅米克尔·阿尔特塔在周二的比赛后表示，他没有与多曼谈论其被罚下的事情，但他补充说：“当我们为这场比赛做准备时，对于必须尊重的事项以及我们在情绪上必须掌控的事项，我们都非常明确。”
在弗利特伍德门将杰伊·林奇扑出布鲁诺·吉马良斯的点球后，19岁后卫康纳·豪希挺身而出，帮助主队晋级四分之一决赛，创造了该赛事历史上最大的冷门之一。弗利特伍德将在八强战中主场迎战另一支英超球队埃弗顿。
由于阿尔特塔轮换了9名首发球员，阿森纳在上半场表现脱节，并在第21分钟被亚伦·卢帕洛-比的进球取得领先。
队长马丁·厄德高在半场替补登场，维克托·哲凯赖什迅速扳平比分，但在林奇在点球大战中大放异彩取得难忘胜利之前，多曼被罚下了场。

items.titleEn: Arsenal and Oakley Meta present We Go Again
items.summaryEn: A new film from Arsenal Football Club and Oakley Meta demonstrates a shared determination to keep pushing forwards
bodyEn: A new film from Arsenal Football Club and Oakley Meta demonstrates a shared determination to keep pushing forwards

We’re proud to launch We Go Again, a film by Arsenal Football Club and Oakley Meta that captures the determination to turn last season’s success into motivation for what comes next. It follows Declan Rice on an early-morning run along our victory parade route through North London, wearing Oakley Meta Vanguard glasses and returning to the streets where we celebrated together. The film reflects a mentality shared by Arsenal and Oakley Meta: celebrate what you’ve achieved, then get back to work.

It is the first project of a new partnership, bringing together two brands united by a shared ambition to keep pushing forwards. For Arsenal, last season's title win was a moment to celebrate everything our players, our supporters and our communities achieved together, and gave us the confidence and motivation to go again. That determination to build on success, put in the work and keep improving is at the heart of this film and partnership.

The players have already been using the Oakley Meta glasses and they were part of the celebrations that inspired the film. Our players took them on last season’s victory parade, enabling them to be present and celebrate with the Gooners who filled the streets of North London.

Now, We Go Again returns to that same route, turning those memories into motivation for what comes next. The early start embodies that relentless pursuit of improvement: staying focused, refusing to give up and pushing for more.

Arsenal Chief Revenue Officer, Omar Shaikh, said: “The trophy parade showed the extraordinary connection that brings Gooners together, from those who filled the streets of North London to the millions around the world who were part of our success. Winning has given us the confidence to think bigger about what Arsenal can be and how we bring our supporters with us. Our partnership with Oakley Meta is part of that ambition, bringing together the power of Arsenal and our communities around the world with Oakley Meta's technology and creativity to create new experiences that bring supporters closer to our club. We're excited to deepen that relationship and see what we can achieve together.”

Eshan Ponnadurai, VP, Wearables at Meta, said: "The spirit of Arsenal and the passion of its supporters resonate with what we see in everyday athletes around the world: a determination to keep going, keep improving and never give up. That shared mentality is what brings Arsenal and Oakley Meta together. For our first project, we wanted to celebrate a moment that meant so much to Arsenal fans and capture how it inspires what comes next. We Go Again connects the joy of last season's celebrations with the drive to get back out there and push for more."
Watch We Go Again across Arsenal and Oakley Meta’s YouTube and Instagram channels today, with behind-the-scenes content and more supporter experiences to come throughout the season.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳与 Oakley Meta 联合发布短片《我们再出发》
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳与 Oakley Meta 合作推出新短片，展现持续前行的坚定决心。
bodyZh: 阿森纳足球俱乐部与 Oakley Meta 推出了一部全新短片，展现了双方不断向前推进的共同决心。

我们很自豪地推出由阿森纳足球俱乐部与 Oakley Meta 联合制作的短片《我们再出发》，该片记录了将上赛季的成功转化为未来动力的高昂斗志。短片跟随德克兰·赖斯（Declan Rice）在清晨沿著我们通过北伦敦的夺冠巡游路线晨跑，他戴着 Oakley Meta Vanguard 眼镜，重返我们曾一同欢庆的街道。这部短片反映了阿森纳与 Oakley Meta 共同秉持的心态：庆祝已取得的成就，然后重返工作岗位。
这是全新合作的第一个项目，将两个因共同追求不断向前而紧密相连的品牌汇聚在一起。对阿森纳而言，上赛季的夺冠是一个值得庆祝的时刻，它凝聚了球员、支持者和社区共同取得的成就，并赋予了我们再次出发的信心与动力。这种在成功基础上再接再厉、付诸努力并持续进步的决心，正是本片和此次合作的核心所在。
球员们已经开始使用 Oakley Meta 眼镜，它们也是激发本片灵感的庆祝活动的一部分。我们的球员在上赛季的夺冠巡游中佩戴了这些眼镜，使他们能够身临其境，与挤满北伦敦街道的枪迷们共同庆祝。
如今，《我们再出发》重返同一条路线，将这些回忆转化为迎接未来的动力。清晨的出发体现了对不断进步的不懈追求：保持专注、永不言弃并争取更多。

阿森纳首席营收官奥马尔·谢赫（Omar Shaikh）表示：“冠军巡游展现了将枪迷紧密连结在一起的非凡纽带，从挤满北伦敦街道的人们到全球数百万分享我们成功喜悦的球迷。胜利赋予了我们更大的信心，去构想阿森纳的未来以及如何与支持者携手前行。我们与 Oakley Meta 的合作正是这一宏伟志向的一部分，它将阿森纳及全球社区的力量与 Oakley Meta 的技术和创意相结合，创造出拉近支持者与俱乐部距离的新体验。我们很高兴能深化这种合作关系，並期待共同取得成就。”

Meta 可穿戴设备副总裁埃善·蓬纳杜赖（Eshan Ponnadurai）表示：“阿森纳的精神与支持者的热情，与我们在全球日常运动员身上看到的品质不谋而合：那就是不断前行、持续进步、永不言弃的决心。这种共同的心态将阿森纳和 Oakley Meta 紧密联系在一起。作为我们的首个项目，我们希望庆祝一个对阿森纳球迷意义重大的时刻，并捕捉它如何启发未来的发展。《我们再出发》将上赛季庆祝活动的喜悦与重返赛场、追求更多成就的动力连结在了一起。”
今天起，您可以通过阿森纳和 Oakley Meta 的 YouTube 以及 Instagram 频道观看《我们再出发》，本赛季还将陆续推出更多幕后内容和球迷体验活动。

items.titleEn: Preview: Arsenal Women v Aston Villa
items.summaryEn: Women’s Super League football returns to Emirates Stadium for Sunday’s visit of Aston Villa in a 12pm kick-off.
bodyEn: Women’s Super League football returns to Emirates Stadium for Sunday’s visit of Aston Villa in a 12pm kick-off.
Get your tickets to cheer us on in N5 as we look to make it three wins in a row in all competitions!
Indeed, the mood has been positive following last weekend’s north London derby victory and Wednesday’s 3-0 success in the UEFA Women’s Champions League against Benfica.
INSTANT IMPACT
Villa have had a similar start to the WSL season to ourselves, having won two, drawn three and lost two of their opening seven fixtures, scoring nine goals and conceding 14 in the process.
They should have a spring in their step after last weekend, when they came away from Goodison Park with a 3-2 win over Everton.
Villa also followed that up with victory over their local rivals, beating Birmingham City 6-5 on penalties after a 1-1 draw in the Subway Players Cup.

An early managerial change may have seemed curious at the time, with Natalia Arroyo making way for former Toffees boss Brian Sorensen at the end of September, but the Dane has turned their fortunes around with seven points from the last three games.
They’ll be hoping for a better result against us than the last time we met in May, when we emerged from Villa Park having put three past them without reply.
RENÉE'S PREVIEW

Slegers: “I think it was always hard to play against Natalia [Arroyo]'s Aston Villa team as well. They would pose a lot of questions. Now, of course, with Brian, they've had a really good start. I think it's four wins and a draw. They won last night through penalties. We remember the game last year, how it was difficult at Emirates for us at home. The away game was good, it was dominant.

"We have to be prepared, we have to be humble. What they're going to do, it's always a guessing game. Of course, they're in a transition now and they've changed their system. Let's see what they do against us. Very often it happens that teams do something different against us. Let's see what their game plan is. We have to focus on ourselves and keep building on our last performance. - Read every word of Renée’s pre-Aston Villa press conference.
TEAM NEWS

We'll be making a late call on the availability of Frida Maanum for this fixture, and Daphne van Domselaar is also getting close to a return. Katie Reid unfortunately suffered an ankle injury in training and isn't expected back before Christmas. Chloe Kelly also isn't available for this weekend.
FACTS AND STATS
We have won eight of our 12 WSL games against Aston Vila (D2 L2), winning 3-0 back in May in the most recent.
Aston Villa drew 1-1 in their most recent top-flight away game against us in September last season, but have never gone unbeaten on back-to-back WSL trips to us.
We remain unbeaten in each of our last 22 WSL home games (W16 D6) – the third longest streak in the competition’s history.
We could become the second team to score 700 WSL goals (currently 699), after Chelsea (707).

Georgia Stanway has scored six goals in four WSL appearances against Aston Villa, her joint-most against any opponent alongside Sunderland and West Ham United. Indeed, the Villans are the only side she has faced more than once in the WSL while boasting a 100% scoring record, having found the net in all four appearances.
MATCH OFFICIALS
Megan Wilson has been appointed to take charge of Sunday’s match, assisted by Ceri Williams and Phoebe Horner, with Alice Parker the Fourth Official.
Wilson has seen over five WSL matches so far this season, handing out eight yellow cards and no reds.
Her last involvement in one of our games was for September 2025’s 5-1 win away to West Ham United.
Referee: Megan WilsonAssistant Referees: Ceri Williams and Phoebe HornerFourth Official: Alice Parker
HOW TO WATCH
Supporters in the UK can watch this match live on Sky Sports Mix. Elsewhere in the world, check out our how to watch article for the full list of international broadcasters.

items.summaryZh: 女足英超联赛重回酋长球场，阿森纳将迎战阿斯顿维拉。
bodyZh: 女足英超联赛重回酋长球场，周日中午12点阿森纳将主场迎战阿斯顿维拉。
快来购买门票，在N5主场为我们呐喊助威，力争各项赛事取得三连胜！
事实上，在上周末赢得北伦敦德比以及周三在欧洲女足冠军联赛中3比0战胜本菲卡之后，球队的士气一直非常高涨。
即时影响
维拉本赛季的英超开局与我们相似，在前七场比赛中取得两胜三平两负，共打入9球，失14球。
在上周末客场3比2战胜埃弗顿之后，她们目前士气正盛。
在经历了一场1比1的平局后，维拉通过点球大战以6比5击败同城死敌伯明翰城，延续了胜势。
九月底时任主帅娜塔莉亚·阿尔罗约下课，前埃弗顿主帅布赖恩·索伦森接任，当时这一早期换帅决定似乎有些奇特，但这位丹麦教练在最近三场比赛中拿下了七分，扭转了球队的命运。
与我们上次在五月交手时相比，她们肯定希望这次能取得更好的结果。当时我们做客维拉公园球场，三球完胜对手。
蕾妮赛前前瞻
斯勒格斯表示：“我认为对阵娜塔莉亚·阿尔罗约执教的阿斯顿维拉一直都很艰难。她们会制造很多难题。当然，现在由布赖恩带队，她们有了一个非常好的开局。我想她们取得了四胜一平。她们昨晚通过点球大战赢了。我们还记得去年在酋长球场的主场比赛有多么艰难。客场比赛则踢得很好，占据了绝对优势。”
“我们必须做好准备，必须保持谦逊。她们会做什么始终是一个未知数。当然，她们现在正处于过渡期，并改变了阵型。让我们看看她们对阵我们时会有什么表现。很多时候，对手对阵我们时总会采取不同的战术。让我们拭目以待她们的比赛计划。我们要专注于自身，并在上一场比赛的基础上继续进步。——阅读蕾妮赛前新闻发布会的全部内容。”
球队消息
我们需要在最后时刻确定弗里达·马努姆能否在本场比赛中出场，达芙妮·范多姆斯拉尔也即将复出。凯蒂·里德不幸在训练中脚踝受伤，预计圣诞节前无法复出。克洛伊·凯利也将缺席本周末的比赛。
比赛数据与统计
我们在12场对阵阿斯顿维拉的英超比赛中赢了8场（2平2负），最近一次是在五月以3比0取胜。
阿斯顿维拉在上赛季九月的顶级联赛客场对阵我们时以1比1战平，但此前从未在客场对阵我们时连续保持不败。
我们在最近22场英超主场比赛中保持不败（16胜6平），这是该项赛事历史上第三长的纪录。
我们有望成为继切尔西（707球）之后第二支在英超打入700球的球队（目前为699球）。
乔治娅·斯坦韦在对阵阿斯顿维拉的4场英超比赛中攻入6球，这是她面对所有对手时的并列最高进球纪录（与桑德兰和西汉姆联并列）。事实上，维拉是她在英超中交手超过一次且保持100%进球率的唯一球队，她在所有4次对阵中都有进球。
比赛裁判
梅根·威尔逊被任命执法周日的比赛，助理裁判为塞里·威廉姆斯和菲比·霍纳，第四官员为爱丽丝·帕克。
威尔逊本赛季已执法超过五场英超比赛，出示了8张黄牌，没有红牌。
她上一次执法我们的比赛是2025年9月客场5比1大胜西汉姆联的比赛。
主裁判：梅根·威尔逊；助理裁判：塞里·威廉姆斯和菲比·霍纳；第四官员：爱丽丝·帕克
如何观看
英国球迷可以通过天空体育Mix频道观看本场比赛直播。世界其他地区的球迷，请查看我们的转播指南文章，获取完整的国际转播商列表。

items.titleEn: Renée: “We have to be prepared and humble”
items.summaryEn: The head coach shared her thoughts on Aston Villa in her pre-match press conference on Thursday
bodyEn: Our quest for three wins in a row in all competitions will be tested by a newly improved Aston Villa side this weekend.
Brian Sorensen took over as their manager in late September and din’t take long to create an upturn in results.
Sunday’s visitors have taken seven points from the last nine available in the Women’s Super League.

Previewing the match in her press conference on Thursday, Renée Slegers said: “I think it was always hard to play against Natalia [Arroyo]'s Aston Villa team as well. They would pose a lot of questions.

“Now, of course, with Brian, they've had a really good start. I think it's four wins and a draw. They won last night through penalties. We remember the game last year, how it was difficult at Emirates for us at home. The away game was good, it was dominant.

“We have to be prepared, we have to be humble. What they're going to do, it's always a guessing game. Of course, they're in a transition now and they've changed their system. Let's see what they do against us. Very often it happens that teams do something different against us. Let's see what their game plan is. We have to focus on ourselves and keep building on our last performance.”

Asked if we have to try to strike a balance between getting short term results while also focusing on long-term squad building, our head coach continued: “The short-term is always important, and the next game we have to make decisions that will help us win.

“That doesn’t mean everything is the same every single game, and those decisions play more into the decisions we make like last night, where we’re dominant and have a two and three-goal lead. That’s when we can start making decisions that look more at the bigger picture, and the short, medium and long-term future.

“It doesn’t mean when something works really well - for example our left side the last two games - that the players there before didn’t work. I’m just happy to see partnerships building and relationships between the players. That’s really good for us that things are clicking with the short turnarounds we have.”

It was pointed out to Renée that, across November, we have just two away trips to look forward to - Liverpool and Barcelona - as we’ll be playing our other four matches at home against Villa, London City Lionesses, Lyon and West Ham United.

“We love to play at home for the fans, and from a travelling perspective, our travelling is always smooth and our facilities are top,” she said. “We have to of course travel to Barcelona, but there are a lot of home games and we love it.

“We’ll be at Emirates Stadium this weekend, the away section was sold out at Tottenham, and our fans were so loud again yesterday which we wanted to really encourage and energise in the first 20 minutes of the game.
“The atmosphere is fantastic at Borehamwood, but we can’t wait to play again at Emirates Stadium in front of our fans.”

items.titleZh: 雷妮：我们必须做好准备并保持谦逊
items.summaryZh: 主教练雷妮在周四的赛前新闻发布会上谈到了本周末对阵阿斯顿维拉的比赛。
bodyZh: 本周末，势头强劲的阿斯顿维拉将对我们各项赛事取得三连胜的目标发起考验。
布莱恩·索伦森于9月下旬接任球队主帅，并不花时间就扭转了球队的战绩。
周日来访的客队在最近三场女超联赛中拿到了七个积分。
雷妮·斯莱格斯在周四的赛前新闻发布会上展望比赛时表示：“我认为过去对阵娜塔莉亚[阿罗约]执教的阿斯顿维拉就一直很艰难，她们会制造很多难题。”
“当然，现在有了布莱恩，她们有了一个非常好的开局。我认为她们取得了四胜一平，昨晚还通过点球赢了比赛。我们记得去年的比赛，我们在酋长球场的主场踢得很艰难，而客场比赛踢得不错且占据了统治地位。”
“我们必须做好准备，我们必须保持谦逊。她们会做什么始终是一个未知数。当然，她们现在正处于过渡期并且改变了阵型。让我们看看她们对阵我们时会怎么做。很多时候，各队对阵我们时都会采取不同的战术。让我们看看她们的比赛计划是什么。我们必须专注于自己，并在上场比赛的基础上继续进步。”
当被问及我们是否必须在追求短期成绩与关注长期阵容建设之间寻找平衡时，我们的主教练继续说道：“短期成绩总是很重要的，下一场比赛我们必须做出有助于我们取胜的决定。”
“这并不意味着每场比赛的情况都完全一样，这些决定更多地体现在像昨晚那样的比赛中，当时我们占据优势并取得了两到三球的领先。那是我们可以开始考虑大局以及短期、中期和长期未来的时刻。”
“这并不意味着当某种战术运转得非常好时——例如我们过去两场比赛的左路——之前的球员就不行。我只是很高兴看到球员之间建立起默契和连结。在赛程紧凑的情况下，事情能够顺利进行对我们真的很好。”
有人向雷妮指出，在整个11月份，我们只有两场客场比赛——分别对阵利物浦和巴塞罗那，因为我们的另外四场比赛都是主场作战，对手分别是维拉、伦敦城雌狮、里昂和西汉姆联。
她说：“我们喜欢为主场球迷踢球，从出行的角度来看，我们的行程总是很顺利，设施也是顶级的。当然我们必须去巴塞罗那客场，但有很多主场比赛，我们很喜欢。”
“我们本周末将在酋长球场比赛，热刺的客队看台票已经卖光了，昨天我们的球迷声音依然非常响亮，我们在比赛前20分钟就希望能极大地鼓舞士气和活力。”
“博勒姆伍德的气氛棒极了，但我们已经迫不及待地想再次在球迷面前的酋长球场踢球了。”

items.titleEn: Every word of Renée’s pre-Villa press conference
items.summaryEn: Renée Slegers was back in front of the media for her pre-Aston Villa press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre
bodyEn: Renée Slegers was back in front of the media for her pre-Aston Villa press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Thursday.
Our head coach shared the latest team news, provided her thoughts on Sunday's return to WSL action at Emirates Stadium and more.
Here's everything she had to say on the following subjects...

on our performance last night:It's less than 12 hours ago that we saw each other, so nice to see everyone again. Very happy with the performance. I think Benfica are a tough side to play against. I think we nullified a lot of what they can bring to the game and strengths they can bring to the game. For example, the duelling and the direct play, which we dealt with really well. We were defensively solid in the game, and we also set ourselves up to be good from counter-attacking moments. I think we created a variety of chances through set-pieces, longer attacks, faster moments, a good percentage of shots on target. I think it was a really sharp performance from the team. There was a starting debut on the pitch, there were new partnerships, there were starters and there were finishers, and of course, Alessia scoring three goals for us. It was a great night together with the fans.

on the mood after two big wins:Of course, it's lighter. You work so hard for the rewards and we are here to win. We've done that twice now, which is great, but we have to back this up as well. We set it after to Spurs in the North London derby and it's the exact same now. It's good, it's two good wins. It was Arsenal, this was us last night, and now we have to back it up with the next game coming up against Villa.

on coming up against Brian Sorensen’s Villa:Of course, knowing from his Everton time, I think it was always hard to play against Natalia [Arroyo]'s Aston Villa team as well. They would pose a lot of questions. Now, of course, with Brian, they've had a really good start. I think it's four wins and a draw. They won last night through penalties. We remember the game last year, how it was difficult at Emirates for us at home. The away game was good, it was dominant. We have to be prepared, we have to be humble. What they're going to do, it's always a guessing game. Of course, they're in a transition now and they've changed their system. Let's see what they do against us. Very often it happens that teams do something different against us. Let's see what their game plan is. We have to focus on ourselves and keep building on our last performance.

on the latest team news:Kim [Little] was back last night, which was great to get her back onto the pitch. There might be a chance Frida Maanum makes it for the game as well. Daphne van Domselaar is getting closer and closer. Maybe a game too early. Katie Reid, she was back training with the team, she got an ankle injury, which sets her back, which is unfortunate, so we don't expect her to be back before Christmas. That's unfortunate for her and that's a setback. Otherwise, the rest is the same as last night.

on when Kelly could return:It's hard to set a clear timeline. It's still day-by-day, seeing how the symptoms are, what we can and can't do, had a specialist appointment a couple of days ago. Let's see where we go from here, but she's not available for the weekend.

on if we’re concerned about injuries and recovery:Of course, you want a full squad available. We've had a couple of injuries in a short period of time. I think they're individual cases. Of course, we analyse together with performance and medical to see if there's anything we could have done differently and how we built them back in. We always know that the return-to-play phase is crucial as well. Of course, unfortunate with Katie Reid and Selina Cerci with a surgery and out for a longer period of time. The positive is that Daph is really close to being back and Frida hopefully as well, if everything goes to plan.

on balancing short-term results with long-term squad building:The short-term is always important, and the next game we have to make decisions that will help us win. That doesn’t mean everything is the same every single game, and those decisions play more into the decisions we make like last night, where we’re dominant and have a two and three-goal lead. That’s when we can start making decisions that look more at the bigger picture, and the short, medium and long-term future. It doesn’t mean when something works really well - for example our left side the last two games - that the players there before didn’t work. I’m just happy to see partnerships building and relationships between the players. That’s really good for us that things are clicking with the short turnarounds we have.

on how to lift players if they’re not hitting their best level:It’s about individuals and what they do themselves, what they focus on and also how we help the players prepare for games. Like I’ve said, the coach’s role is within, but players can also be contagious for each other with their positivity. We’re focusing a lot on humble actions and small things that create margins in the moments for us. If we do that consistently well, and you see your teammate in a positive action, it inspires you to do it as well. They’ve helped each other a lot lately and that’s come through in the last two games, but we now have to back it up in the next one.

on if Reuteler and Batlle can be a long-term solution on the wing:We have a lot of quality players on both sides. Ona and Geraldine had a really great partnership yesterday, it was growing throughout the game, and they said themselves afterwards as well. Ona was great with her forward intent, runs, crosses, so that’s great to have. We also have other good players in those positions, so it’s about how we use the squad most effectively, game-by-game and also in the long-term.

on having only two away games in November and four at home:We love to play at home for the fans, and from a travelling perspective. That said, our travelling is always smooth and our facilities are top. We have to of course travel to Barcelona, but there are a lot of home games and we love it. We’ll be at Emirates Stadium this weekend, the away section is sold out, and our fans were so loud again yesterday which we wanted to really encourage and energise in the first 20 minutes of the game. The atmosphere is fantastic at Boreham Wood, but we can’t wait to play again at Emirates Stadium in front of our fans.

on how Reid is after her setback:Of course, upset and gutted when it happened. That's something you don't want at all when you're ready. It's physically, mentally taxing to come back from a long-term injury. And she's learned so much during that period of time. You build character, you build robustness physically, mentally. But then she has to deal with another setback within a setback. And this is the real challenge. But Katie is such a strong, positive person. She's going to grow from this. She's going to take this challenge, this adversity, this obstacle as something that is going to make her better. And we are all in it with her. She has the full support from her teammates. She'll get through this and she's going to come back better. Unfortunately, it's not before Christmas. We don't expect before Christmas. I wish that was the case. She looked really good back in team training. It was really nice to see her training, her composure on the ball, the calmness, the physical qualities that she brings. So unfortunately, we'll have to wait a little bit longer to get Katie back. She's young, so she has a big future ahead of her. And she's going to take this experience with her and it's going to make her stronger.

on if we have to think about players getting minutes with the World Cup approaching:I think the period we've been through with Arsenal there's been a lot of focus on us and nothing else to get things right. We work really hard to get the wins and that's what we've done. So that's where all our energy has gone, for me, for the players. But I also know, and it's something we spoke about in pre-season, it is a driver for a lot of players. Most of the players in our squad are national team players and fighting for places in the World Cup. It's, of course, the dream of every young player to ever play in a World Cup and represent your country. So we know that that's a driver for players. We have our own interests, of course. We need to do everything possible to get Arsenal winning. But we also understand that we want to do everything we can to help the players perform. And I think if we do that well and create an environment here, the chances will get bigger to get the wins with Arsenal and to get a place in the squad for the national teams.

on having to keep multiple goalkeepers happy with Van Domselaar returning soon:All I know is that things change quickly. But it's just very nice to see Daphne back in our training sessions. She brings so much quality. She looks good. So it's really exciting to get her back competing for the spot. Everyone knew this with the season start, that the goalkeepers look around and they see that there are five goalkeepers there in our training environment, including Amy Liddiard. And everyone is competing. So that's the contract you sign with Arsenal. That's what we want to do. We know that we have a lot of games and they're competing for the spot. So that's what they will do. And they're all great goalkeepers. They have a strong union together. They will support each other. They will compete for it, but they will support each other.

on how Foord has impressed this week:She's been massive for us. She's been a leader with the intensity and the fight she brings on the pitch. And that's what we spoke about ahead of Spurs, the north London derby. We needed fight, grit on the pitch, duels. And she brings that. That's one of her big qualities in the game. And she injects that into the team. The way she plays is contagious. And she's been so important for us in that game. And with that performance and everything she brought and everything we expected we needed against Benfica, because we expected fight there as well. We wanted her to be on the pitch again. And she had a great 90 minutes again for us. She scores the 4-0 goal. The way she does it, it's a wide combination. And she sprints at high speed. She sprints into the box to get into that situation and finishes it. I think we have to get some clarity on what player was offside in that moment. So, gutted for her. She didn't get the goal. And goal difference can become important as well in the league phase. But yes, she had her 50th appearance for Arsenal in the Champions League last night. That tells you everything about what she's done for Arsenal for so long. The player that she is. And she's in great form right now.

items.summaryZh: 雷妮出席索布哈地产训练基地赛前发布会，谈到球队近况、伤情及周末对阵维拉。
bodyZh: 蕾妮-斯勒格斯于周四在索布哈地产训练基地出席了对阵阿斯顿维拉前的赛前新闻发布会。
我们的主教练分享了最新的球队阵容消息，并谈到了她对周日重返酋长球场参加女足超级联赛（WSL）等话题的看法。
以下是她就以下几个主题所说的一切……

关于我们昨晚的表现：距离我们见面还不到12小时，很高兴再次见到大家。对表现非常满意。我认为本菲卡是一个很难对付的对手。我认为我们化解了他们在比赛中展现出的许多能力和优势。例如对抗和直接进攻，我们处理得非常好。我们在比赛中防守稳健，同时也为反击时刻做好了准备。我认为我们通过定位球、较长时间的进攻、更快的节奏创造了各种机会，射正率也很高。我认为球队表现非常敏锐。场上有首秀，有新的搭档，有首发球员，也有替补登场的球员，当然阿莱西亚还为我们打进了三球。与球迷们度过了一个美妙的夜晚。
关于取得两场大胜后的心情：当然，心情轻松多了。为了回报，你付出了那么多努力，我们来这里就是为了赢球。我们现在已经做到了两次，这很好，但我们也必须延续这种状态。我们在北伦敦德比对阵热刺后就说过这一点，现在也完全一样。很好，这是两场精彩的胜利。这就是阿森纳，这就是我们昨晚的状态，现在我们必须在接下来对阵维拉的比赛中延续这种状态。

关于对阵布莱恩-索伦森的维拉：当然，从他在埃弗顿的执教经历来看，我认为与娜塔莉亚[阿罗约]的阿斯顿维拉交手一直都很艰难。他们会提出很多问题。当然，现在由布莱恩带队，他们有了一个很好的开局。我想是四胜一平。他们昨晚通过点球大战取胜。我们还记得去年在酋长球场主场踢得多么艰难。客场比赛踢得很好，占据了统治地位。我们必须做好准备，必须保持谦逊。他们会做什么，这总是需要猜测的。当然，他们现在处于过渡期，并且改变了阵型。让我们看看他们对阵我们时会怎么做。很多时候，球队对阵我们时会做出不同的举动。让我们看看他们的比赛计划是什么。我们必须专注于自己，并在上一场表现的基础上继续前进。
关于最新球队消息：金[莉特]昨晚回归了，很高兴能让她重返球场。弗里达-马纳姆也有机会赶上这场比赛。达芙妮-范多姆塞拉尔越来越近了。也许这场比赛还为时过早。凯蒂-里德，她之前恢复了与球队的合练，但脚踝受伤导致她再次缺阵，这很不幸，所以我们预计她在圣诞节前不会复出。这对她来说不幸且是一个挫折。除此之外，其余情况和昨晚一样。
关于凯利何时能复出：很难设定一个明确的时间表。目前仍然是每天观察，看症状如何，能做什么和不能做什么，几天前刚看过专家的预约。让我们看看从这里开始怎么走，但她周末无法出场。
关于我们是否担心伤病和恢复情况：当然，你希望拥有一个完整的阵容。我们在短时间内遇到了一些伤病。我认为这些都是个别情况。当然，我们与体能和医疗团队一起进行分析，看看是否有我们可以做得更好的地方以及我们如何帮助他们恢复。我们始终知道恢复比赛阶段同样至关重要。当然，凯蒂-里德和塞莉娜-切尔西接受手术并长期缺阵令人遗憾。积极的一面是，如果一切按计划进行，达芙妮非常接近复出，弗里达也希望如此。

关于平衡短期成绩与长期阵容建设：短期总是很重要的，在接下来的比赛中，我们必须做出有助于我们取胜的决定。这并不意味着每场比赛的决定都完全一样，这些决定更多地体现在像昨晚这样的比赛中，当时我们占据统治地位并取得了两到三球的领先优势。那时我们可以开始做出更多顾及大局、兼顾短期、中期和长期未来的决定。这并不意味着当某种战术运转得非常好时——例如我们过去两场比赛的左路——以前在那里的球员就不行。我很高兴看到球员之间的搭档和联系正在建立。随着赛程紧凑，事情能够顺利进行，这对我们来说真的很好。

关于如果球员没有达到最佳水平时如何激励他们：这关乎个人以及他们自己做了什么，他们专注于什么，以及我们如何帮助球员为比赛做好准备。正如我所说，教练的角色在内部，但球员也可以通过他们的积极态度相互感染。我们非常关注那些能够在关键时刻为我们创造优势的谦逊举动和细节。如果我们能始终如一地做好这一点，并且看到队友有积极的举动，这也会激励你去做。他们最近互相帮助了很多，这在前两场比赛中得到了体现，但我们现在必须在下一场比赛中继续保持。
关于鲁特勒和巴特尔能否成为边路的长期解决方案：我们在两边都有很多高水平的球员。奥娜和杰拉丁昨天有着非常棒的搭档关系，随着比赛的进行这种默契在不断增长，她们赛后自己也这么说。奥娜在向前意识、跑动和传中方面表现出色，有这样的球员真的很棒。我们在这些位置上还有其他优秀的球员，所以关键在于如何最有效地使用阵容，一场比赛一场比赛地来，同时也着眼于长远。

关于11月只有两场客场而有四场主场：我们喜欢在主场为球迷们踢球，从旅行的角度来看也是如此。话虽如此，我们的旅行总是很顺利，我们的设施是一流的。当然我们必须前往巴塞罗那，但有很多主场比赛，我们很喜欢。这个周末我们将在酋长球场比赛，客队看台的门票已经售罄，我们的球迷昨天再次发出了巨大的呐喊，我们希望在比赛前20分钟真正鼓励和激发这种氛围。博勒姆伍德球场的氛围非常棒，但我们已经迫不及待地想再次在酋长球场在球迷面前踢球了。

关于里德遭遇挫折后的状态：事情发生时当然感到沮丧和难过。当你准备好时，这绝对是你最不想看到的。从长期伤病中恢复过来，在身体和精神上都是一种煎熬。她在那个时期学到了很多东西。你会建立性格，在身体和精神上建立韧性。但随后她又不得不应对挫折中的又一次挫折。这就是真正的挑战。但凯蒂是一个非常坚强、积极的人。她会从这次经历中成长。她会把这个挑战、逆境和障碍当作让她变得更好的东西。我们都和她在一起。她得到了队友的全力支持。她会挺过这一关，并且会以更好的状态回归。不幸的是，复出不会在圣诞节之前。我们预计不会在圣诞节之前。我希望情况是那样。她在恢复球队训练时看起来真的很棒。很高兴看到她的训练、她在球场上的镇定、冷静以及她带来的身体素质。所以不幸的是，我们必须再等一段时间才能让凯蒂回归。她还年轻，所以未来有无限可能。她会带着这段经历，这会让她变得更强。

关于随着世界杯临近是否必须考虑球员的出场时间：我认为我们和阿森纳经历这段时期以来，有很多焦点都在我们身上，没有别的，就是为了把事情做好。我们非常努力地赢下比赛，这也是我们所做的。所以这就是我们所有精力倾注的地方，对我和球员们来说都是如此。但我也知道，这也是我们在季前赛中谈论过的事情，它是许多球员的动力。我们阵容中的大多数球员都是国家队员，正在为世界杯的名额而战。踢世界杯并代表祖国出战当然是每个年轻球员的梦想。所以我们知道这是球员的动力。当然，我们也有自己的利益。我们需要尽一切可能让阿森纳赢球。但我们也理解，我们希望尽一切所能帮助球员发挥。我认为如果我们把这一点做好，在这里创造一个环境，那么在阿森纳赢得比赛并获得国家队阵容名额的机会就会更大。

关于随着范多姆塞拉尔即将回归如何让多名门将保持开心：我只知道事情变化很快。但看到达芙妮回到我们的训练课中真是太好了。她带来了如此高的水平。她看起来状态很好。所以很高兴能让她回来竞争这个位置。赛季开始时大家都知道这一点，门将们环顾四周，会发现我们的训练环境中包括艾米-利迪亚尔在内有五名门将。每个人都在竞争。这就是你与阿森纳签下的合同。这就是我们想要做的。我们知道我们有很多比赛，她们都在争夺这个位置。所以她们会这么做的。而且她们都是出色的门将。她们之间有着紧密的团队精神。她们会互相支持。她们会为此竞争，但她们会互相支持。

关于福特本周如何留下深刻印象：她对我们意义重大。凭借她在球场上展现出的强度和拼劲，她一直是一名领袖。这就是我们在对阵热刺的北伦敦德比前所谈论的。我们需要球场上的拼劲、韧劲和对抗。而她带来了这些。这是她在比赛中的一大特质。她将这种特质注入了球队。她的踢球方式极具感染力。在那场比赛中，她对我们至关重要。凭借那场比赛的表现、她带来的一切，以及我们对阵本菲卡时预期的需求，因为我们预计那里也会有激烈的拼抢。我们希望她再次出场。她再次为我们踢满了精彩的90分钟。她打进了第四个进球。她的进球方式是一次边路配合。她高速冲刺。她冲刺进禁区参与那个局面并完成射门。我认为我们需要弄清楚那一刻到底是哪个球员越位了。所以，为她感到遗憾。她没有得到那个进球。在联赛阶段，净胜球有时也会变得很重要。不过是的，昨晚是她代表阿森纳在欧冠中的第50次出场。这说明了她长期以来为阿森纳所做的一切，以及她所具备的球员素质。她现在状态大好。

items.titleEn: Disabled Supporters' Ticket Info | Tottenham Hotspur (A)
bodyEn: Tottenham Hotspur v ArsenalSunday 6th December Premier LeagueTottenham Hotspur StadiumKick Off: 16:30

All tickets for this game will be NFC Digital Passes and will be sent to each lead client and must be added to a mobile device prior to arrival at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Please ensure that your email address details are up to date.
Tickets will be sent from Tuesday, December 1. If you have not received your tickets by Thursday, December 3, please contact our Supporter Services Team on 020 7619 5000 (option 1).
Supporters aged 13 and under must be accompanied by an adult ticket holder over the age of 18 when entering the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
Please read the matchday information for details on what to expect when visiting the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium – Visiting Supporters Information.

We ask that you only purchase a ticket if you are planning to attend the match. Our goal is to ensure that as many supporters as possible have the chance to attend this game, and that our away support remains vibrant and passionate.
When attending away fixtures, please ensure that your match ticket is scanned. It is your responsibility to make sure that your ticket is scanned correctly at the turnstile.
If your match ticket does not scan at the relevant turnstile, or if a steward admits you through another entrance, please ensure that your ticket is scanned before entering the ground.

If you do have access issues on the day of the game, please speak to a steward or seek advice from the hosting club’s ticket office before entering the ground to confirm that your match attendance is recorded.

Arsenal monitors away match attendance from access control data which is recorded at the hosting club’s ground. Arsenal receives this information directly from the hosting club and uses the data to confirm attendance or to deduct away match points.
Please be aware that documentation will not be accepted to prove away match attendance and this includes photographs, receipts, travel or hotel bookings.

If you fail to scan your away match ticket, Arsenal will not receive information that you attended the fixture, and the away match loyalty point that has been credited to your membership account will be removed for the relevant away game.
The club also reserves the right to implement further point removals for repeated occurrences as set out under section 3.10 of the Arsenal Away Match Ticket Terms and Conditions Season 2026-2027.
Allocation Information Wheelchair spaces – 26 pairsAmbulant disabled seating – 30 pairs
Disability Access Ticket Prices
Wheelchair Users and Ambulant Disabled
Tickets for disabled supporters will be priced at the relevant age category and will include a complimentary personal assistant ticket, subject to eligibility.
Sales Phases

From this season, Red, Cannon, Junior Gunners, and Young Gun DA Members will now be able to earn away points on all eligible fixtures. These points will build your priority for future away matches, giving you access to the ticket purchase window based on the away points you’ve accumulated.
Sales Window 1 Tickets will go on sale on Monday 2nd November at 10am to all Disability Access members with 35+ Away points.
Sales Window 2 Tickets will go on sale on Monday 2nd November at 2pm to all Disability Access members with 30+ Away points.
Sales Window 3 Tickets will go on sale on Tuesday 3rd November at 10am to all current Disability Access members with 25+ Away points.
Sales Window 4 Tickets will go on sale on Tuesday 3rd November at 2pm to all current Disability Access members with 20+ Away points.
Sales Window 5Tickets will go on sale on Wednesday 4th November at 10am to all Disability Access members with 15+ Away points.
Sales Window 6Tickets will go on sale on Wednesday 4th November at 2pm to all current Disability Access members with 10+ Away points.
If tickets remain after window 6, we will announce further sales windows.

To book tickets please call 0207 619 5000 (option 2). Please be aware that the phone line can be busy at times so you may be held in a queue. Deaf supporters, who use British Sign Language (BSL), can contact the Disability Liaison Team by using SignVideo BSL Interpreter service.

Please note, if you wish to purchase in a 2pm booking period, you will be entered into a queue at 1.45pm before the phone lines re-open to you at 2pm. If you qualify in the previous booking period and haven’t purchased prior to this time, you will need to purchase in the new booking period.
Away Ticket ExchangeThe Away Ticket Exchange service will open once this fixture has sold out.

Supporters collecting duplicate tickets on the day of the fixture, will be required to provide photo ID. The ID must match the name on the assigned ticket and photographs of ID are not valid. Third party ticket collections are also not permitted.

As ticket exchange is not currently available online for disabled supporters, you can register your interest in tickets via a form once the match has sold out. If any tickets are returned, we will contact supporters on a first come first served basis.

Please fill in this form if you are interested in attending. This form will only open once the fixture has sold out and will close on Monday 1st December at 5pm. If any tickets become available, we will contact you at the earliest opportunity.
Accessible Parking InformationIf you require parking, please let us know at your point of purchase.
Audio Descriptive CommentaryIf you require Audio Descriptive Commentary for this fixture, please fill in our contact us form.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳公布客场对阵托特纳姆热刺的残疾球迷门票及售票阶段信息。
bodyZh: 托特纳姆热刺对阵阿森纳12月6日星期日英超托特纳姆热刺球场开球时间：16:30
本场比赛的所有门票均为NFC数字通行证，将发送给每位主联系人，必须在抵达托特纳姆热刺球场之前将其添加至移动设备。请确保您的电子邮箱地址是最新的。
门票将于12月1日星期二开始发送。如果您在12月3日星期四之前仍未收到门票，请拨打020 7619 5000（选择1）联系我们的球迷服务团队。
13岁及以下的球迷进入托特纳姆热刺球场时，必须由18岁以上的成人持票人陪同。
请阅读比赛日信息，了解访问托特纳姆热刺球场的注意事项 – 访问球迷信息。
我们恳请您仅在计划现场观赛的情况下购票。我们的目标是确保尽可能多的球迷有机会观看本场比赛，并保持我们客场球迷的热情与活力。
观看客场比赛时，请确保您的比赛门票被扫描。您有责任确保您的门票在闸机处被正确扫描。
如果您的比赛门票未能在相关闸机处扫描，或者工作人员让您通过其他入口进入，请务必在进入球场前扫描您的门票。
如果在比赛当天遇到入场问题，请在进入球场前与工作人员交谈或向主办俱乐部的售票处寻求建议，以确认您的现场观赛记录已被录入。
阿森纳通过主场俱乐部球场记录的出入控制数据来监控客场比赛出席情况。阿森纳直接从主场俱乐部接收此信息，并利用这些数据来确认出勤情况或扣除客场积分。
请注意，证明客场比赛出勤率的文件将不被接受，包括照片、收据、行程或酒店预订。
如果您未能扫描客场比赛门票，阿森纳将不会收到您出席比赛的信息，并且已记入您会员账户的相关客场比赛忠诚度积分将被移除。
根据《2026-2027赛季阿森纳客场比赛门票条款和条件》第3.10条的规定，俱乐部也保留对重复发生的情况实施进一步扣除积分的权利。
分配信息轮椅席位 – 26对行动不便座位 – 30对
残疾通道门票价格
轮椅使用者及行动不便者
残疾球迷的门票将按相关年龄段定价，并在符合条件的情况下包含一张免费的个人助理门票。
销售阶段
从本赛季开始，红色会员、大炮会员、青年枪手和青年DA会员现在将能够从所有符合条件的比赛中获得客场积分。这些积分将建立您未来客场比赛的优先权，让您根据累积的客场积分获得购票窗口期。
销售窗口 1 门票将于 11 月 2 日星期一上午 10 点向拥有 35 分及以上客场积分的所有残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口 2 门票将于 11 月 2 日星期日下午 2 点向拥有 30 分及以上客场积分的所有残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口 3 门票将于 11 月 3 日星期二上午 10 点向拥有 25 分及以上客场积分的所有当前残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口 4 门票将于 11 月 3 日星期二下午 2 点向拥有 20 分及以上客场积分的所有当前残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口 5 门票将于 11 月 4 日星期三上午 10 点向拥有 15 分及以上客场积分的所有残疾通道会员开售。
销售窗口 6 门票将于 11 月 4 日星期三下午 2 点向拥有 10 分及以上客场积分的所有当前残疾通道会员开售。
如果窗口 6 之后仍有剩余门票，我们将宣布进一步的销售窗口。
如需预订门票，请致电 0207 619 5000（选择 2）。请注意，电话有时可能会很忙，因此您可能会在队列中等待。使用英国手语 (BSL) 的聋哑球迷可以使用 SignVideo BSL 翻译服务联系残疾人联络团队。
请注意，如果您希望在下午 2 点的预订时段购买，您将在下午 1 点 45 分进入队列，然后在下午 2 点电话重新对您开放。如果您符合上一预订时段的资格且在此之前未购买，您将需要在新的预订时段购买。
客场门票兑换一旦本场比赛售罄，客场门票兑换服务将开放。

items.titleEn: ‘This isn’t supposed to happen’: giant-slaying Fleetwood revels in fairytale Arsenal win

bodyEn: On a wet and windy night on the north-west coast of England, a League Two side sensationally knocked the Premier League champions out of the Carabao Cup. But this is not just a fairytale story of giant-slaying: Fleetwood Town and Arsenal have an unlikely history that stretches back long before Tuesday night’s game.
Arsenal played at their iconic Highbury stadium until 2006, and Fleetwood’s ground has the same title, being named after Highbury Avenue, the adjoining street.

Fleetwood also play in red shirts with white sleeves in the style of the classic Arsenal kit. Nobody is exactly sure why, but according to Ray Curtis, a barman in the town’s King’s Arms: “Fleetwood’s first ever kit, the home kit, was given to them by Arsenal.”
And in the 2000s, not long after Patrick Vieira captained Arsenal, Fleetwood boasted a namesake star: a Brazilian striker called Magno Vieira.

At the 5,300-capacity Highbury on Wednesday morning, the floodlights that Fleetwood had hired for the occasion were being packed away. “It’s back to reality, back to being a League Two team, that’s our normal,” said Zsofia Wright, the ticket office and retail manager.

On Tuesday, the excitement and anticipation started early. “We started getting what team had turned up, who’d flown in, and the whispers started, and it’s like, ‘oh, they’ve gone quite strong’,” Wright said.
“So we were all planning to just enjoy the occasion. And then obviously, we went 1-0 up and everyone was kind of looking at each other, like this isn’t supposed to be happening.”
She said it was back to reality when Arsenal equalised except that “the clock kept on going and the score didn’t change”.

Wright said everyone was on the pitch after the dramatic penalty shootout that saw the Premier League champions and Champions League finalists ousted from the competition. The next stop for players, fans and management was the stadium bar.
“Just incredible,” Wright said. “We were here till about half one last night. It was brilliant, amazing.”

“The atmosphere was crazy,” said Chris Newman, 33, who was at the match with his son. He returned to the club shop on Wednesday to pick up two souvenir programmes. “Everything happened so quick,” he said. “I just didn’t expect it at all.”

The shop has done a roaring trade over the past 36 hours, with half-and-half Fleetwood and Arsenal scarves proving especially popular. One buyer with a London accent said: “I’m a Spurs fan, it’s brilliant.”

Wright said the town was abuzz the morning after: “Bars, pubs that are struggling, they were open till God knows what time yesterday. We just hope it can continue throughout the season, just hope that attendances start to pick up, and get consistency back again through the gates.”
The club’s nicknames – the Cod Army, the Fishermen, the Cods and the Trawlermen – all derive from the Lancashire town’s fishing industry.

Sharon Brooks, who was visiting a fishmonger by the harbour, said: “We thought it’d be three, four or five nil, but they did so well to get a draw and then win on penalties, and five brilliant penalties. It’s nice for a town like Fleetwood, and [against the] Premier League winners last season, they just surprised you didn’t they?”
Her 12-year-old son, Ryan, who is an Arsenal fan, said: “Even though I wanted [Arsenal] to win it, I’m pleased for them.”
In the King’s Arms, everyone was eagerly awaiting Wednesday night’s draw, which will decide who Fleetwood plays next.

Donald Maclean, who missed the game because he was on duty at a nursing home, said: “I saw the goals this morning and I was delighted, over the moon, imagine Fleetwood taking down the Gunners! Never been heard of before, so yes, we’re all delighted about it. Brilliant!”
The Cod Army’s victory has delighted fans partly because it was so unexpected – Fleetwood sit 84 places below Arsenal in the football league pyramid.
Michael Houton said he had thought the result impossible “because Arsenal shouldn’t have got beaten should they? Not against Fleetwood.”

Paul Dagger was so pessimistic about his team’s chances that he had staked £200 at half-time on Arsenal to win at odds of 10/7. “Gyökeres [of Arsenal] scored within five minutes of the start,” he said. “I thought, oh here we go, money’s coming in now. You live and learn.”
Fleetwood fans hope it will be the start of something bigger than just a victory for lovers of the game. “The town needs it,” Dagger said. “As you can see, it’s full of charity shops and vape shops.”
Garry Gill, a retired crane operator, said: “I am a Fleetwood fan and I think it’s fantastic for the town. It’s going to bring coin.
“If they play with the determination they did last night, any team that comes to play now is going to be frightened. And normally, that’s not the case, they think it’s an easy win.”
Jim Buckley said: “It’s magic. We’re a Mickey Mouse town of 25,000 people, there’s no train station. I mean at the Emirates, they can fit three towns the size of this town in there.”
He was not far out – Arsenal’s stadium can hold 60,000 fans.
The drinkers in the King’s Arms said the travelling Arsenal fans had had a good day out despite the embarrassing defeat.
Dagger said: “Two pound twenty a pint in here, two pound fifty a pint over the way. They couldn’t believe it, they were going, facking ‘ell, it’s eight quid where we are.”

Back near the harbour, at the Shark Chippy, there was a lunchtime rush. Dishing up cod and chips, Bethany Taylor said she lived near the ground and could tell the result from the roar of the crowd and the flares. “It was good, brilliant,” she added. “We weren’t expecting it.”
“It’s an incredible result isn’t it?” said her colleague Louisa Smith.
But do they think Fleetwood can lift the Carabao Cup? “It’d be a struggle, but hopefully they will,” Smith said. “We wish them luck.”

items.titleZh: “这本不该发生”：弗利特伍德击败阿森纳尽享童话般胜利
items.summaryZh: 英乙球队弗利特伍德点球大战淘汰阿森纳，小镇沉浸在奇迹胜利的喜悦中。
bodyZh: 在英格兰西北海岸一个又湿又风大的夜晚，一支英乙球队在联赛杯中爆冷将英超冠军淘汰出局。但这不仅仅是一个以下克上的童话故事：弗利特伍德镇和阿森纳之间有着一段可以追溯到周二比赛很久之前的奇妙渊源。
阿森纳曾在他们标志性的海布里球场踢球直到2006年，而弗利特伍德的主场也叫这个名字，它是以临近的街道海布里大道命名的。
弗利特伍德也穿着带有白袖的红色球衣，风格与阿森纳的经典球衣相似。没有人确切知道原因，但据镇上“国王之臂”酒吧的酒保雷·柯蒂斯称：“弗利特伍德的第一套主场球衣是阿森纳送给他们的。”
在2000年代，就在帕特里克·维埃拉担任阿森纳队长后不久，弗利特伍德也拥有一位同名球星：一名名叫马格诺·维埃拉的巴西前锋。
周三早晨，在容量5300人的海布里球场，弗利特伍德为这场比赛临时租用的泛光灯正在被打包收起。“一切回到了现实，回到了做一支英乙球队的状态，这才是我们的常态，”售票兼零售经理佐菲亚·赖特说道。
周二时，兴奋和期待很早就开始了。“我们开始打听对方派出了什么阵容、谁飞抵了这里，各种传闻开始出现，就像是，‘噢，他们派出了挺强的阵容’，”赖特说。
“所以我们都只是打算享受这场比赛。然后很明显，我们以1比0领先，每个人都有点面面相觑，觉得这本不该发生。”
她说当阿森纳扳平比分时一切回到了现实，只不过“时钟一直在走，比分却没有改变”。
赖特表示，在经历惊心动魄的点球大战、淘汰了英超冠军和欧冠亚军之后，所有人都冲进了球场。球员、球迷和管理层的下一站是球场酒吧。
“简直难以置信，”赖特说。“我们昨晚在这里待到了大约一点半。太棒了，太神奇了。”
“气氛太疯狂了，”33岁的克里斯·纽曼和他的儿子一起观看了比赛，他周三回到俱乐部商店挑选了两本纪念场刊。“一切发生得太快了，”他说。“我根本没料到。”
过去36小时里，这家商店的生意非常兴隆，印有弗利特伍德和阿森纳各半的围巾格外受欢迎。一位带着伦敦口音的买家说：“我是热刺球迷，这太棒了。”
赖特说，镇上的居民在次日清晨依然兴致勃勃：“那些平时苦苦挣扎的酒吧昨天开到了鬼知道几点。我们只希望这种势头能贯穿整个赛季，希望上座率开始回升，让球场的入场人数恢复稳定。”
该俱乐部的绰号——鳕鱼军团、渔夫们、鳕鱼和拖网渔船——都源于兰开夏郡这个小镇的渔业。
正在港口鱼贩处买鱼的莎伦·布鲁克斯说：“我们以为会是三、四或五比零，但他们踢得太棒了，不仅扳平还在点球大战中取胜，而且罚进了五个精彩的点球。对于弗利特伍德这样的小镇来说这很好，而且对手还是上赛季的英超冠军，他们真的让你大吃一惊，不是吗？”
她12岁的儿子瑞安是阿森纳球迷，他说：“尽管我希望阿森纳赢，但我为他们感到高兴。”
在“国王之臂”酒吧里，大家都在热切期待周三晚上的抽签，这将决定弗利特伍德的下一个对手是谁。
唐纳德·麦克林因为要在疗养院值班而错过了比赛，他说：“我今天早上看到了进球，我太高兴了，欣喜若狂，想象一下弗利特伍德击败了枪手！以前从未听说过，所以是的，我们对此都感到很高兴。太棒了！”
鳕鱼军团的胜利让球迷们欣喜若狂，部分原因是它如此出人意料——弗利特伍德在英格兰足球联赛金字塔中比阿森纳低了84位。
迈克尔·霍顿表示，他曾认为这个结果是不可能的，“因为阿森纳本不该输球，对吧？尤其不是对阵弗利特伍德。”
保罗·达格对球队的机会感到非常悲观，以至于他在中场休息时下注200英镑押阿森纳以10/7的赔率取胜。“（阿森纳的）约克雷斯在开场五分钟内就进球了，”他说。“我想，噢，开始了，钱这就要进账了。人总是活到老学到老。”
弗利特伍德的球迷希望这不仅是足球爱好者的胜利，还能成为更大成就的开始。“这个镇子需要这个，”达格说。“如你所见，这里到处都是慈善商店和电子烟店。”
退休起重机操作员加里·吉尔说：“我是一个弗利特伍德球迷，我认为这对小镇来说太棒了。这会带来财富。”
“如果他们能像昨晚那样带着决心踢球，任何来这里踢球的球队都会感到害怕。通常情况下并非如此，他们会觉得这是一场轻松的胜利。”
吉姆·巴克利说：“这太神奇了。我们是一个只有25,000人口的米老鼠小镇，这里没有火车站。我的意思是，在酋长球场，可以装下三个我们这样大小的小镇。”
他说得差不多——阿森纳的球场能容纳60,000名球迷。
“国王之臂”的酒客们表示，尽管遭遇了令人尴尬的失利，远道而来的阿森纳球迷还是度过了愉快的一天。
达格说：“这里一品脱啤酒卖二英镑二十便士，对面卖二英镑五十便士。他们简直不敢相信，他们一直在说，卧槽，我们那里要八镑。”
回到港口附近的鲨鱼薯条店，正值午餐高峰期。贝瑟尼·泰勒在盛着炸鱼薯条时说，她住在球场附近，从人群的欢呼声和信号弹就能猜出比赛结果。“很好，太棒了，”她补充道。“我们根本没料到。”
“这是一个令人难以置信的结果，对吧？”她的同事路易莎·史密斯说。
但他们认为弗利特伍德能捧起联赛杯吗？“这会很艰难，但希望他们能做到，”史密斯说。“我们祝他们好运。”

items.titleEn: Max Dowman’s Fleetwood fracas leaves him, Arsenal and Arteta red-faced
items.summaryEn: Teenager was maybe harshly sent off in the Carabao Cup tie but his reaction was a mistake he will learn from, while his manager might also have regretsMikel Arteta’s reaction said it all. bodyEn: Mikel Arteta’s reaction said it all. As Max Dowman trudged towards the touchline after becoming the youngest player sent off in a League Cup match at 16 years and 300 days, the Arsenal manager could not help himself.

Arms folded across his chest like an angry father who has caught his teenage son sneaking in after midnight, Arteta leaned over and aimed a few choice words in Dowman’s direction before the forward headed sheepishly down the tunnel. What he said remains unknown, although that hasn’t stopped the amateur lip-readers speculating on social media. “Get in the changing room. Now,” appears the most likely guess.

There is no doubt Arteta had made up his mind about the incident that ended with Dowman seeing red for reacting to an overaggressive sliding tackle from Fleetwood’s Harrison Neal. Although Arsenal intend to appeal and Arteta told Sky after the shock penalty shootout defeat by the League Two side 84 places below them in the pyramid that he wanted to watch it again before “assessing the situation”, the Spaniard made no excuses for Dowman in his post-match press conference.

“It was something that we discussed before the game,” he said when asked about their touchline exchange. “We knew when we prepared the context of the match, we were very clear on the things to expect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate.”

Whether Dowman’s reaction warranted a straight red card remains open to debate given there was minimal force when he lifted his right knee towards Neal. The referee, Michael Salisbury, could easily have decided to give both players a yellow and defused the situation, especially given Cole Palmer was booked for barging into Tottenham’s Matheus Fernandes off the ball on Saturday in what seemed a far more aggressive act. But, as Wayne Rooney and David Beckham infamously found to their cost while playing for England at the World Cup, acts of petulance are not usually tolerated by officials. Dowman was deemed to have overstepped the line.

It is a pressure Arteta has warned the record-breaking teenager would have to deal with as Dowman’s reputation has grown. Only last month Dowman was sent off playing for England Under-19s against the USA after a poorly timed tackle that most present at the behind-closed-doors match deemed a harsh decision. He was said to have been on the receiving end of a host of strong challenges in that match. Last year, Arteta urged Dowman to follow the example of Bukayo Saka after revealing Dowman was fouled nine times in a the first half of an England Under‑19s game against Spain.

“It’s going to happen, he’s going to have to learn when to release the ball and when to attract his starting position,” Arteta said. “Very similar to Bukayo in the beginning as well. Those players are going to attract players, contact, attention and they have to be very smart about when you want that contact and when you don’t want it, and what you have to do to avoid it.”

Asked how Dowman tends to react, he said: “He just gets up … very rare! Sometimes I get surprised emotionally how cool he can be. I think it’s about repetition. He’s so used to it that now he knows to let the referee deal with it and my teammates probably to defend me, and I will carry on playing.”

When the dust settles after a seismic defeat that ranks alongside Arsenal’s League Cup upsets against Swindon, Birmingham and Bradford, Arteta may come to regret such a public admonishment of a 16-year-old. His actions were criticised by Paul Merson, who questioned whether Areta would “do it differently” given another chance. But part of Arteta’s frustration will be that Dowman took the bait. He also knows opponents will now target Dowman even more to see whether they can provoke a reaction.

If Arsenal’s appeal fails, Dowman’s immediate punishment will be a three-match domestic suspension, causing him to miss Sunday’s trip to Liverpool and games against Hull and Newcastle. The timing is far from helpful: Saka’s thigh injury, expected to keep him out for several weeks, had opened up the possibility of more game time in the Premier League and Noni Madueke did not travel to Fleetwood owing to an ankle issue.

Dowman burst on to the scene last year by becoming the first 15-year-old to play in the Champions League, then broke the Premier League’s youngest goalscorer record against Everton in March, and this is the first major setback in his fledgling career.

He has been training with the first team since he was 14 and Arsenal have been extremely careful not to overexpose one of the most talked about players to emerge from their Hale End academy. Arteta resisted the temptation to give him many more minutes in the Premier League after Dowman scored twice against Ipswich in the previous round of the Carabao Cup last month. The challenge will be how Dowman responds to the extra scrutiny – on and off the pitch – that is bound to come his way.
items.author: Ed Aarons
items.titleZh: 马克斯·道曼与弗リート伍德的冲突让阿森纳与阿尔特塔感到尴尬
items.summaryZh: 道曼在联赛杯中染红引发关注，阿尔特塔赛后对此进行了严厉批评。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔的反应说明了一切。当16岁零300天的马克斯·道曼成为联赛杯中被罚下的最年轻球员，步履蹒跚地走向场边时，这位阿森纳主帅按捺不住自己的情绪。
阿尔特塔双臂交叉在胸前，就像一个抓到十几岁的儿子半夜偷偷溜回家的愤怒父亲，他俯身朝道曼的方向说了几句狠话，随后这位前锋灰溜溜地走进了球员通道。他说的话目前不得而知，但这并没有阻止业余唇语专家在社交媒体上进行猜测。“回更衣室去。现在，”这似乎是最有可能的猜测。
毫无疑问，阿尔特塔已经对这起事件做出了决定。此前，弗リート伍德球员哈里森·尼尔（Harrison Neal）的动作过大，道曼因做出反应而吃到红牌。尽管阿森纳打算上诉，且这家比阿森纳低84个名次的英乙球队在点球大战中爆冷淘汰阿森纳后，阿尔特塔在接受天空体育采访时表示他想先看回放再“评估形势”，但在赛后新闻发布会上，这位西班牙主帅并没有为道曼找借口。
当被问及他们场边的交流时，他说：“这是我们在赛前讨论过的事情。当我们准备这场比赛的背景时，我们对应该预料到的事情以及我们在情感上必须控制的事情非常清楚。”
考虑到道曼将右膝抬向尼尔时力量微乎其微，他的反应是否理应直接吃到红牌仍有待商榷。主裁判迈克尔·萨利斯伯里本可以轻易决定向两名球员出示黄牌以平息事态，尤其是考虑到科尔·帕尔默周六在无球状态下撞击热刺球员马特乌斯·费尔南德斯时只吃到黄牌，这看起来是一个更具侵略性的动作。但是，正如韦恩·鲁尼和大卫·贝克汉姆当年代表英格兰队参加世界杯时付出沉重代价一样，官员们通常不会容忍任性的行为。道曼被认为越界了。
阿尔特塔曾警告过这位打破纪录的少年，随着道曼名声的增长，他将不得不应对这种压力。就在上个月，道曼代表英格兰U19对阵美国队时，因一次时机不佳的铲球而被罚下场，当时在场的多数人都认为这是一次严厉的判罚。据说他在那场比赛中多次遭到凶狠的拼抢。去年，阿尔特塔敦促道曼以布卡约·萨卡为榜样，此前他透露道曼在英格兰U19对阵西班牙的上半场比赛中被侵犯了九次。
阿尔特塔说：“这种事还会发生，他必须学会什么时候出球，什么时候吸引防守位置。这和布卡约刚出道时非常相似。这些球员会吸引防守球员、身体接触和注意力，他们必须非常聪明，知道什么时候需要这种接触，什么时候不需要，以及该怎么做才能避免。”
当被问及道曼通常如何反应时，他说：“他只是站起来……非常罕见！有时他在情绪上能表现得如此冷静，这让我感到惊讶。我认为这是重复的力量。他已经习以为常，现在他知道让裁判去处理，队友大概会保护我，然后我会继续踢球。”
在一场与阿森纳此前在联赛杯对阵斯温顿、伯明翰和布拉德福德的爆冷失利相提并论的震撼失利尘埃落定之后，阿尔特塔可能会对公开斥责一名16岁球员感到后悔。他的行为受到了保罗·默森的批评，后者质疑阿尔特塔如果再有一次机会是否会“做得不同”。但阿尔特塔感到沮丧的部分原因在于道曼上了钩。他也知道，对手现在会更加针对道曼，看看能否激怒他。
