如果阿森纳的上诉失败，道曼受到的即时惩罚将是国内禁赛三场，这将导致他错过周日对阵利物浦的比赛，以及对阵赫尔城和纽卡斯尔的比赛。这个时机非常糟糕：萨卡的腿筋受伤预计将让他缺阵数周，这本为他在英超联赛中获得更多出场时间创造了可能，而农尼·马杜埃凯由于脚踝问题并未随队前往弗リート伍德。
道曼去年崭露头角，成为在欧冠出场的最年轻15岁球员，随后在3月份对阵埃弗顿的比赛中打破了英超最年轻进球纪录，这是他刚起步的职业生涯中遭遇的第一个重大挫折。
他从14岁起就一直在随一线队训练，阿森纳一直非常小心，避免过度使用这位从黑尔端青训营走出来的备受瞩目的球员。在上个月联赛杯上一轮对阵伊普斯维奇打进两球后，阿尔特塔克制住了在英超联赛中给他更多出场时间的诱惑。接下来的挑战将是，道曼将如何应对随之而来的场内外的额外审视。

items.titleEn: ‘What you live for’: Fleetwood revel in seismic Arsenal shock after Dowman sees red
items.summaryEn: Manager Lawlor reflects on ‘unbelievably special’ nightArsenal youngster sent off for retaliation before shootout Fleetwood’s manager, Matt Lawlor, hailed the club’s victory as one for all football after his side shocked the Premier League champions, Arsenal, on penalties in the Carabao Cup. The side 18th in League Two held their nerve in the shootout, Conor Haughey hitting the winner to reach the quarter-finals.The goalkeeper, Jay Lynch, was Fleetwood’s other hero, saving from Bruno Guimarães to set up the chance for victory. Aaron Loupalo‑Bi and Viktor Gyökeres ensured it finished 1-1 in normal time, but Arsenal ended up a man light after Max Dowman was shown a red card for reacting to a challenge. Continue reading...
bodyEn: Fleetwood’s manager, Matt Lawlor, hailed the club’s victory as one for all football after his side shocked the Premier League champions, Arsenal, on penalties in the Carabao Cup. The side 18th in League Two held their nerve in the shootout, Conor Haughey hitting the winner to reach the quarter-finals.

The goalkeeper, Jay Lynch, was Fleetwood’s other hero, saving from Bruno Guimarães to set up the chance for victory. Aaron Loupalo‑Bi and Viktor Gyökeres ensured it finished 1-1 in normal time, but Arsenal ended up a man light after Max Dowman was shown a red card for reacting to a challenge.

Asked if Fleetwood’s win was the story of the season, Lawlor said: “Yeah, I hope so. Football’s getting a little bit more, I don’t know, clinical and sanitised. And that to me there was that feeling that we all get as football fans. That was what you kind of live for, isn’t it? To be a part of it is special. To be giving that to football fans, and especially Fleetwood fans, is unbelievably special. And yeah, something that I’m really proud of.”

Lawlor was clearly emotional at full-time as many of the 4,000 home supporters streamed on to the pitch to celebrate beating a team 84 places above them. “I was trying to not cry and I didn’t. I’ve managed to hold it,” he said. “My family, my little boy here, we’re all local. I was turning around and people were screaming at me in the crowd and people that I knew and grew up with, that I went to school with or they’ve got a loose connection, and people that jumped out on to the pitch.
“That’s really special and really emotional. To do something that special early in my career as well, it’s an emotional night. It is emotional. Emotional for the players, emotional for me.”

This was Dowman’s second red card of the month, having been sent off for England Under-19s, providing a steep learning curve for the talented teenager. Mikel Arteta was clearly unimpressed:“When we prepare the context of the match, we were very clear on the things you expect, the things that emotionally we have to dominate.
“It was very clear,” added Arteta, who appeared to aim criticism at Dowman as he walked past him after being sent off.
items.author: Will Unwin at Highbury
items.titleZh: 弗利特伍德点球大战淘汰阿森纳，主帅劳勒盛赞这是足球的胜利
items.summaryZh: 弗利特伍德在联赛杯点球击败阿森纳晋级八强，主帅劳勒盛赞这是一个特别的夜晚。
bodyZh: 在联赛杯中点球爆冷击败英超冠军阿森纳后，弗利特伍德主教练马特·劳勒盛赞这场胜利属于所有热爱足球的人。这支英乙排名第18位的球队在点球大战中顶住压力，康纳·霍吉罚入制胜球，帮助球队闯入八强。
门将杰伊·林奇是弗利特伍德的另一位英雄，他扑出了布鲁诺·吉马良斯的点球，为胜利奠定了基础。阿隆·卢帕洛-比和维克托·哲凯赖什常规时间各进一球战成1-1，但马克斯·多曼因对拼抢做出反应被红牌罚下，导致阿森纳少一人作战。
当被问及弗利特伍德的胜利是否是本赛季的最大新闻时，劳勒说：“是的，我希望如此。足球变得越来越有些严谨和流于表面。对我来说，那种感觉正是我们所有球迷所追求的。这就是你活着的意义，不是吗？能成为其中一部分很特别。能将这一点带给球迷，尤其是弗利特伍德球迷，简直是不可思议的特别。是的，这让我感到非常自豪。”
终场哨响时，劳勒显然情绪激动，多达4000名主场球迷涌入球场庆祝击败一支排名比他们高出84位的球队。“我一直在努力不哭，我成功忍住了，”他说，“我的家人、我年幼的儿子都在这里，我们都是本地人。我转过身，人群中有我认识的、一起长大的、一起上学的人在对我尖叫，还有涌入球场的人们。”
“这真的很特别，也很情绪化。在我职业生涯的早期就能做到如此特别的事情，这是一个令人激动的夜晚。确实很激动。对球员来说很激动，对我也很激动。”
这是多曼本月吃到的第二张红牌，此前他曾在代表英格兰U19队比赛时被罚下，这为这位才华横溢的年轻人上了一堂深刻的成长课。米克尔·阿尔特塔显然很不满意：“当我们为比赛做准备时，我们对你所期望的事情、在情感上我们必须掌控的事情非常清楚。”
阿尔特塔补充道：“这非常清楚。”在多曼被罚下场从他身边走过时，阿尔特塔似乎对其实施了批评。

items.titleEn: Fleetwood Town stun Arsenal on penalties: Carabao Cup fourth round – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Fourth-tier Fleetwood produced one of the League Cup’s biggest ever shocks, defeating the champions 5-3 on penalties after a 1-1 drawHere’s the Fleetwood head coach, Matt Lawlor: “We’ve had to make changes, with the champions in town. But we’ve got a plan with substitutions to manage the game. Arsenal have paid us a lot of respect by naming such a strong team … it’s a very difficult challenge, but one we should enjoy, and not be overawed.”“I was just thinking, with the two Highburys – I can only think of the St James(’) Parks (Exeter and Newcastle), but are there any other grounds with very similar names?” asks Shaun T. Continue reading...
bodyEn: I’ll leave you with Will Unwin’s report from Highbury, where it won’t be a quiet night at the library. Thanks for joining me. Night!

Next up for Arsenal: another tricky trip to the northwest, this time to Anfield, where Liverpool await. Then it’s back to the Champions League, against Slavia Prague. As for Fleetwood, it’s Bristol Rovers on Saturday, then Rochdale in the FA Cup.

Well, that was a strange interview. I can understand Arteta not wanting to go nuclear – Arsenal could easily have nicked a late winner, and this defeat isn’t going to make or break their season. Still, I’m not sure Fleetwood were tremendously lucky to take the game to penalties, and Arsenal having more chances is surely the bare minimum their manager should expect.
On the Dowman red card, Arteta says he will “watch it back properly and assess the situation”. Will he learn from this? “We all learn from everything, yeah.”
He says there was “no problem with attitude” in his team: “if there was, I’d be out here, absolutely fuming.” He says he feels sad, rather than angry, because his team did enough to win the game.

Here’s Mikel Arteta: “First of all, I congratulate Fleetwood for getting through. I cannot fault the effort of the players, we had so many chances, so many shots … it shouldn’t have come down to penalties.”

“They went ahead, [but] we gave them almost nothing all game, didn’t capitalise on the chances we had and then it comes down to such small margins … that’s the beauty of football, [but] it’s a very sad day.”
“The football cods are smiling down on Fleetwood,” says Peter Oh. Ian Sargeant adds: So much for West Ham being the last team to beat Arsenal at Highbury.”

More from Matt Lawlor: any plans for the rest of the evening? “We’ve got the day off … we’ll leave the cars parked at the training ground!” Who do they want next? “Another big tie will help, for a club in our position … is it the quarter-finals next? I don’t even know!”
What a great interview. He clearly prepared in great detail for this game, but never dreamed his team could actually win. I sense Arteta may not be quite so jovial.
Here’s Matt Lawlor, the Fleetwood manager. “I’ve just told the players to enjoy it, but we’ve got a game on Saturday,” he chuckles. “I didn’t want to tell them!”

“We’re not stupid enough to think we’re going to outplay the best team in the country. We just tried to deny them space, deny them opportunities. I’m so glad the lads put that performance in – they’ve made everyone in the town so proud.”

Were they prepared for penalties? “We haven’t practiced once!” Lawlor admits. “A 19-year-old centre-back took the last one, and buried it! We were deep, in a low block … I forgot we were going straight to penalties, I was worried about extra time!”

Some dates for your diary, Fleetwood fans. The quarter-final draw takes place on Wednesday, after Liverpool v Chelsea. The last-eight ties will take place in the week starting 14 December; the Cods and Bradford City will be the only non-Premier League teams in the draw.

“The star of the show was clearly the little girl with a giant sparkly hat and a Fleetwood scarf on her dad’s shoulders to the right of the goal, where the penalty kicks were taken,” writes Kari Tulinius. “What a night she’s having! She’ll remember that for the rest of her life.”

Jay Lynch talks to Sky! “My voice has gone! The whole team was magnificent, every one of them. We took heart from Grimsby beating Manchester United last season, it felt comparable. It means so much to the whole town.”
Conor Haughey is asked to describe his winning spot-kick. In a broad Ulster accent, he says: “I smashed it in and then ran like fuck.” Lovely stuff.

Fans pour onto the pitch as Fleetwood players run to embrace their kids on the touchline. The Captain Pugwash theme blares from the PA. The manager, Matt Lawlor, has tears in his eyes – he can’t believe what he’s just seen. Neither can I.

Fleetwood are into the quarter-finals, beating a team 84 places above them in the pyramid – and in reality, the gulf is even bigger than that. Cup football, eh? They’ve tried to kill it, but the magic will never die.
It’s centre-back Conor Haughey who steps up … and smashes it into the top corner. Fleetwood, 18th in League Two, have dumped Arsenal out of the Carabao Cup!

Straightforward stuff from Gyokeres, who blooters it into the top corner.
Davies scores! Fleetwood 3-2 Arsenal
The breeze whips up, nudging the ball off the spot – but Will Davies is unfazed, whipping the ball in the opposite direction as Meslier dives to his left.
Havertz scores! Fleetwood 2-2 Arsenal
Kai Havertz, waster of many chances tonight, sends Lynch the wrong way to level things up.
Neal scores! Fleetwood 2-1 Arsenal
Perhaps Fleetwood’s best player on the night, Harrison Neal steps up … and belts it into the roof of the net!
Odegaard scores! Fleetwood 1-1 Arsenal
Right in the corner, beyond Lynch’s despairing dive.
Fleetwood 1-0 Arsenal: Coughlan strokes the ball into the corner to open the shootout, with Meslier going the wrong way.
Here we go, then. Because of Dowman’s red card, one Fleetwood player has to sit this out – it’s Jake Batty who draws the short (or long?) straw.
Fasten your seatbelts – we’re going to penalties.
94 mins: At the other end, Rooney’s cross is shanked into the air by Ben White, and Meslier can’t keep it in play. Corner … headed away by Konsa at the near post.
93 mins: Eze miscontrols the ball but is then brought down, and Arsenal have a free kick. It’s worked to Guimaraes, who floats the ball … straight into Lynch’s gloves.
92 mins: Another chance! Eze gets another chance to whip the ball in and find Havertz, whose downward header spins wide of goal!
91 mins: Another save from Lynch, this time tipping Odegaard’s swerving effort away. Havertz appealed for a penalty, and there’s another shout for handball as Eze’s cross hits Haughey.
90 mins: Huge save! It looks like Arsenal have got out of jail here, with Ben White unmarked and shooting on goal from eight yards out … but Lynch repels it at his near post!

88 mins: Andy Cannon was also booked in that skirmish, while Mikel Arteta did not look remotely impressed with Dowman as he trudged off, offering only a frosty word or two in the teenager’s direction.

There’s a scuffle between Dowman and Neal near the halfway line, and the Arsenal youngster appears to strike out after a hefty challenge. There’s an almighty melee before Michael Salisbury intervenes … and sends Max Dowman off! It looks harsh on first view, but Arsenal will have to see this out with 10 men.
83 mins: Oof! Andy Cannon can see the headlines, but his header is blocked by Meslier and from the rebound, the keeper is down quickly to block Will Davies’ shot from a tight angle.
82 mins: For Arsenal, Bruno Guimaraes and Ezri Konsa replace Zubimendi and Lewis-Skelly. Will Davies is on for Fleetwood, in place of goalscorer Loupalo-Bi.
81 mins: Eze fires an aimless effort into a wall of red shirts, then is flagged offside when the ball comes back to him. Some more changes coming up …
79 mins: A sniff of a half-chance for Loupalo-Bi as he breaks into the Arsenal half, but Mosquera shakes him off the ball before Coughlan can catch up.
FT: Bradford 2-0 Peterborough The League One promotion-chasers are into the quarter-final draw. Can Fleetwood join them? Ten-odd minutes to go …
76 mins: It’s full attack-v-defence now, but Ben White releases the pressure by wandering offside. Behind the Fleetwood goal, we can see a solitary lad watching from his bedroom window.
74 mins: Odegaard’s delivery is half-dealt with, before Havertz crunches a cross into the side netting.
73 mins: It’s time! Andy Cannon is on, replacing Mark Helm. There’s a free kick to deal with before any heroics, with Batty booked for hauling Dowman down.
72 mins: It’s played short and Dowman goes for goal, but his effort from 18 yards is held by Lynch at the near post.
71 mins: The Fleetwood fans are still in fine voice, with chants for Rooney, Coughlin and “boring, boring Arsenal” – who have won a corner after Lewis-Skelly’s shot was blocked.
70 mins: Arsenal deal with the corner when Batty steps offside, but the clock keeps ticking, and penalties are now just over 20 minutes away.

68 mins: Coughlan has been in decent goalscoring form and makes his presence felt straight away, jostling the Arsenal centre-backs and earning a throw-in. There’s also a bit of afters between the towering Shaun Rooney and Odegaard, who does a good job of not looking scared.
66 mins: And a change for Arsenal, with Eberechi Eze replacing O’Neill, who set up the equaliser as part of a very promising performance.
65 mins: Ched Evans and Crispin McLean are going off, replaced by two Irish players – striker Ronan Coughlan and midfielder Adam Murphy.

items.titleZh: 弗リート伍德镇点球大战爆冷淘汰阿森纳：联赛杯第四轮比赛实录
items.summaryZh: 第四级别球队弗リート伍德镇在点球大战中以5比3击败阿森纳，创造了联赛杯历史上的最大冷门之一。
bodyZh: 我将以Will Unwin发自海布里的报道结束今天的直播，今晚这里的图书馆可不会安静。感谢大家的陪伴，晚安！
阿森纳的下一场比赛：又是一场艰难的西北远征，这次他们将做客安菲尔德对阵利物浦。随后他们将回到欧冠赛场迎战布拉格斯拉维亚。至于弗リート伍德镇，他们周六将对阵布里斯托尔流浪者，然后将在足总杯中对阵罗奇代尔。
好吧，这是一场奇怪的采访。我可以理解阿尔特塔不想反应过度——阿森纳本可以轻松在最后时刻绝杀，而这场失利也不会决定他们的赛季成败。不过，我不确定弗リート伍德镇把比赛拖入点球大战纯粹靠的是运气，而阿森纳创造更多机会绝对是他们主帅应该达到的最低要求。
关于道曼的红牌，阿尔特塔表示他将“好好回看录像并评估形势”。他会从中吸取教训吗？“我们从所有事情中都能学到东西，是的。”
他说他的球队“在态度上没有问题”：“如果有的话，我会站在这里大发雷霆了。”他说他感到难过，而不是愤怒，因为他的球队表现得足以赢得比赛。
米克尔·阿尔特塔说道：“首先，我祝贺弗リート伍德镇晋级。我不能挑剔球员们的努力，我们创造了那么多机会、那么多射门……本来不该进入点球大战的。”
“他们领先了，[但]我们整场比赛几乎没给他们什么机会，却没有把握住我们创造的机会，然后比赛就取决于微小的差距……这就是足球的魅力，[但]这是非常悲伤的一天。”
“足球之神在保佑弗リート伍德镇，”彼得·奥（Peter Oh）说道。伊安·萨金特（Ian Sargeant）补充道：“说什么西汉姆联是最后一支在海布里击败阿森纳的球队，简直是个笑话。”
马特·劳勒（Matt Lawlor）的更多采访内容：对剩下的时间有什么安排？“我们今天放假……我们会把车停在训练基地！”他们下一轮想对阵谁？“对于我们这个位置的俱乐部来说，另一场大战会有所帮助……下一轮是四分之一决赛吗？我甚至都不知道！”
多棒的采访啊。他显然为这场比赛做了非常详细的准备，但从未梦想过他的球队真的能赢。我感觉阿尔特塔可能没那么高兴。
这是弗リート伍德镇主帅马特·劳勒。“我刚刚告诉球员们好好享受，但我们周六还有一场比赛，”他笑着说，“我本不想告诉他们的！”
“我们还没蠢到认为自己能击败国内最好的球队。我们只是试图剥夺他们的空间，剥夺他们的机会。我很高兴小伙子们踢出了这样的表现——他们让全镇的人都感到骄傲。”
他们为点球大战做好准备了吗？劳勒承认：“我们连一次都没练习过！”“一个19岁的中后卫罚进了最后一个点球！我们当时站位很深，摆出低位防守……我忘了我们要直接踢点球，我还在担心加时赛呢！”
弗リート伍德镇的球迷们，记下几个重要日期吧。四分之一决赛的抽签仪式将于周三利物浦对阵切尔西的比赛后举行。八强战将于12月14日开始的那一周进行；神射手队（The Cods）和布拉德福德城将是抽签中仅有的两支非英超球队。
卡里·图利纽斯（Kari Tulinius）写道：“全场的明星显然是坐在她爸爸肩膀上的那个小女孩，她戴着巨大的闪光帽子，在进球右侧的球门旁围着弗リート伍德镇的围巾。”“她今晚过得太棒了！她一辈子都会记住这一晚的。”
杰伊·林奇（Jay Lynch）接受天空体育采访！“我的嗓子哑了！全队都太棒了，每一个人都是。我们从上赛季格林斯比镇击败曼联中受到了鼓舞，感觉很相似。这对整个小镇意义重大。”
康纳·霍伊（Conor Haughey）被要求描述他制胜的点球。他带着浓重的阿尔斯特口音说：“我一脚怒射，然后像他妈的疯了一样跑了起来。”太棒了。
球迷们涌入球场，弗リート伍德镇的球员们跑向边线拥抱他们的孩子。公共广播系统里播放着《小木偶帕格沃什船长》的主题曲。主帅马特·劳勒眼里含着泪水——他不敢相信自己刚刚看到的一切。我也不敢相信。
弗リート伍德镇晋级四分之一决赛，击败了一支在联赛体系中比他们高出84位的球队——而实际上，这之间的鸿沟还要更大。这就是杯赛足球，不是吗？他们曾试图抹杀它，但它的魔力永远不会消逝。
是中后卫康纳·霍伊站了出来了……一脚怒射轰入球门右上角。英乙排名第18位的弗リート伍德镇将阿森纳淘汰出了联赛杯！
林奇扑出了吉马良斯的点球！
弗リート伍德镇 4-3 阿森纳：林奇倒地扑出了布鲁诺·吉马良斯的糟糕射门，弗リート伍德镇可能已经稳操胜券了……
坎农罚进！弗リート伍德镇 4-3 阿森纳
他当然能罚进。目前为止主罚的七个点球都干净利落地罚进了……
约克雷斯罚进！弗リート伍德镇 3-3 阿森纳
约克雷斯罚得很干脆，一脚怒射将球轰入球门右上角。
戴维斯罚进！弗リート伍德镇 3-2 阿森纳
微风大作，把球从罚球点吹开——但威尔·戴维斯镇定自若，在梅利耶向左扑救的同时将球兜入球门另一侧。
哈弗茨罚进！弗リート伍德镇 2-2 阿森纳
今晚错失良机的凯·哈弗茨骗过了林奇，将比分扳平。
尼尔罚进！弗リート伍德镇 2-1 阿森纳
作为今晚弗リート伍德镇表现最好的球员之一，哈里森·尼尔站了出来……一脚劲射轰入球门顶端！
厄德高罚进！弗リート伍德镇 1-1 阿森纳
皮球直奔死角，越过了绝望扑救的林奇。
弗リート伍德镇 1-0 阿森纳：科夫兰将球推入死角为点球大战首开纪录，梅利耶判断错了方向。
那么，开始了。由于道曼的红牌，弗リート伍德镇必须有一名球员轮休——杰克·巴蒂抽到了短（或长？）签。
系好安全带——我们要进入点球大战了。
94分钟：在另一端，鲁尼的传中被本·怀特解围到空中，梅利耶没能将球留在场内。角球……被孔萨在近门柱头球解围。
93分钟：埃泽停球失误随后被放倒，阿森纳获得任意球。球传给了吉马良斯，他将球吊入……正好落入林奇的手套中。
92分钟：又一次机会！埃泽再次获得传中找到哈弗茨的机会，后者的头球攻门偏出了球门底线外！
91分钟：林奇再次做出扑救，这次他扑出了厄德高带弧线的射门。哈弗茨此前在禁区内倒地索要点球，而当埃泽的传中击中霍伊时，场上又响起了一声手球的呼喊。
90分钟：神扑！阿森纳看起来在这里死里逃生了，本·怀特在无人防守的情况下在码外起脚射门……但林奇在近门柱将球挡出！
88分钟：安迪·坎农在那次冲突中也被黄牌警告，而米克尔·阿尔特塔对蹒跚离场的道曼看起来一点也不满意，只对这名少年说了寥寥几句冷冰冰的话。
道曼和尼尔在中线附近发生冲突，这名阿森纳小将在激烈的拼抢后似乎有报复动作。在迈克尔·索尔兹伯里介入之前发生了一场大混战……并将马克斯·道曼罚下！初看之下这个判罚有点严厉，但阿森纳不得不以10人应战撑到最后。
83分钟：哎呀！安迪·坎农看到了头条新闻在向他招手，但他的头球攻门被梅利耶挡出，随后这位门将迅速倒地封堵了威尔·戴维斯小角度的射门。
82分钟：阿森纳方面，布鲁诺·吉马良斯和埃兹里·孔萨替换下了祖比门迪和刘易斯-斯凯利。威尔·戴维斯替补登场替下了进球功臣卢帕洛-比。
81分钟：埃泽毫无目的地将球射向红衣人墙，随后在球回到他脚下时被判越位。还有更多换人即将到来……
79分钟：卢帕洛-比突破进入阿森纳半场时获得了一次半单刀机会，但在科夫兰赶到之前，莫斯克拉将球断下。
全场比赛结束：布拉德福德 2-0 彼得伯勒。这支英甲冲超球队晋级四分之一决赛抽签。弗リート伍德镇能加入他们的行列吗？还有十来分钟……
76分钟：现在完全成了进攻对防守的演练，但本·怀特因越位缓解了压力。在弗リート伍德镇球门后面，我们可以看到一个孤独的男孩正从他的卧室窗户观看比赛。
74分钟：厄德高的传中被半解围，随后哈弗茨一脚抽射打在了边网上。
73分钟：时机到了！安迪·坎农替补登场，换下马克·赫尔姆。在进行任何英雄壮举之前，他们还得先处理一个任意球，巴蒂因放倒道曼而被黄牌警告。
72分钟：战术角球开出，道曼起脚攻门，但他码外的射门被林奇在近门柱稳稳抱住。
71分钟：弗リート伍德镇的球迷依然在引吭高歌，高喊着鲁尼、科夫兰的名字以及“无聊的阿森纳”——此前刘易斯-斯凯利的射门被封堵，阿森纳获得了一个角球。
70分钟：阿森纳化解了这个角球，巴蒂随后被判越位，时间在一分一秒流逝，距离点球大战还有20多分钟。
68分钟：科夫兰保持着不错的进球状态，他一上场就展现了自己的存在感，与阿森纳中后卫激烈拼抢并赢得了一个界外球。身材高大的肖恩·鲁尼和厄德高之间也发生了一些小摩擦，厄德高很好地控制了自己的情绪，显得毫不畏惧。
66分钟：阿森纳做出换人调整，埃贝雷奇·埃泽替换下奥尼尔，后者此前表现相当出色并策动了扳平比分的进球。
65分钟：切德·埃文斯和克里斯平·麦克林离场，被两名爱尔兰球员替换下场——前锋罗南·科夫兰和中场亚当·墨菲。

items.summaryEn: It is more than 20 years since Arsenal played at Highbury but their trip to League Two Fleetwood – and a stadium of the same name – did not bring back fond memories as they were dumped out of the Carabao Cup on penalties. bodyEn: It is more than 20 years since Arsenal played at Highbury but their trip to League Two Fleetwood – and a stadium of the same name – did not bring back fond memories as they were dumped out of the Carabao Cup on penalties. It was the team with red shirts and white sleeves that triumphed, but on this occasion it caused one of the greatest upsets in English football history.

Aaron Loupalo-Bi and Viktor Gyökeres exchanged goals in normal time but Arsenal were unable to find a winner, despite being the dominant force, as Fleetwood battled to the end. The home manager, Matt Lawlor, was almost in tears, unable to cope after the tension was released when Conor Haughey smashed the ball into the top corner to settle the shootout.

That came after Jay Lynch had saved from Bruno Guimarães, a former warehouse worker stopping the Brazilian international. It is the storylines everyone wants but so rarely gets in the sanitised modern football world.

Fleetwood were aiming to earn £400,000 from the night but got something priceless in the end. Everyone in attendance will never forget they saw the fourth-tier side knock out the Premier League champions. Of course they had to ride their luck and were helped by Max Dowman’s debatable sending off but football is rarely about logic, it is one of emotion. This is once in a lifetime for the Cod Army, for anyone at their level, and they enjoyed it.

A year ago Lawlor was not even a football manager, he never played professionally and started his coaching career with the Manchester United Foundation. Lynch had spent much of his early career in non-league, only dreaming of playing a team who narrowly lost the Champions League final in the spring.

Everyone was expecting a routine victory, even with Mikel Arteta giving youngsters the chance to impress. If Arteta wanted to test his youngsters then Marli Salmon’s naivety was shown up by Loupalo-Bi, on loan from Fulham.

He has been learning his trade in the fourth tier this season and put into practice the skill of using his body against a defender, spinning and holding off the 17-year-old before slotting under Illan Meslier to bring lift-off for the second time of the night.

By that point the game had already had a six-minute delay due to a drone being flown above the pitch. The referee Michael Salisbury had to take the players to the sidelines while the police searched for the culprit outside the ground. It was an unordinary start to what became an extraordinary night on the Fylde Coast. It had started with a plethora of pyrotechnics that created a red haze across the pitch and, frankly, it never dissipated, literally or metaphorically.

The first half was one of toil for Arsenal, unable to create anything meaningful, constantly being thwarted by the disciplined defence, well organised by Lawlor and his staff. The Gunners were pedestrian against a team happy to watch them go through the motions. Kai Havertz missed the best chance to equalise before the break but his header was wayward, summing up a difficult match for him.

After the break it was different as Martin Ødegaard came on to become the quarterback for Arsenal, creating the rhythm they had sorely lacked. He brought cohesion and intensity, getting them back into the game.

It was Gyökeres who bundled home the equaliser and few would have doubted Arsenal going on to win the match but Fleetwood held firm.

The home side had been direct from the start, accepting their limitations and knowing the conditions would help them. Swirling wind helped hold the ball up in the sky and confused defenders not used to the gales by the sea.

Fleetwood’s robust play irritated Arsenal and Dowman was wound up, getting himself sent off for reacting to enforcer-in-chief Harrison Neal. He was the second Gunners teenager to learn a valuable lesson of life outside the top flight after Salmon was exposed for the goal.

It may have been harsh but it was needlessly petulant from Dowman on an already challenging night for his side. Mikel Arteta had a word with him on the way off. What did Arteta say? “Something that we discussed already before the match.”

Arsenal had two late chances through Ben White and Gyökeres to settle it before the need for spot-kicks, but Lynch produced two fantastic saves as the clock went past 90 minutes to ensure it went to a fittingly dramatic finale, where he could be the hero again on a great night for football and the town of Fleetwood.

items.titleZh: 弗利特伍德点球大战淘汰阿森纳爆出联赛杯冷门
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳在联赛杯点球大战中负于英乙球队弗利特伍德，惨遭淘汰。
bodyZh: 距离阿森纳在海布里球场比赛已经过去20多年了，但他们客场对阵英乙球队弗利特伍德（以及同名球场）的经历并没有留下美好回忆，他们在联赛杯中通过点球大战被淘汰出局。获胜的是身穿红白球衣的球队，但这一次它创造了英格兰足球历史上最大的冷门之一。
常规时间内，亚伦·卢帕洛-比与维克托·约克雷斯交替进球，尽管阿森纳占据绝对优势且弗利特伍德顽强抵抗，但枪手未能找到制胜球。主教练马特·劳勒几乎激动得流下眼泪，当康纳·霍伊利把球轰入球门顶角锁定胜局、紧张情绪释放后，他几乎无法控制自己。
在此之前，杰伊·林奇扑出了布鲁诺·吉马良斯的射门，这位前仓库工人扑出了这位巴西国脚的罚球。这是每个人都想看到、但在高度商业化的现代足球世界里极其罕见的剧情。
弗利特伍德本场比赛的目标是赚取40万英镑，但最终得到了无价之宝。所有在场的观众永远不会忘记，他们亲眼目睹了一支第四级别球队淘汰了英超冠军。当然，他们也需要一些运气，并受益于马克斯·多曼有争议的红牌罚下，但足球很少讲究逻辑，它关乎情感。对鳕鱼军团以及任何处于他们这个水平的人来说，这是一生难得的经历，他们享受了这一刻。
一年前，劳勒还不是一名足球教练，他从未踢过职业足球，并从曼联基金会开始了其执教生涯。林奇的大部分早期职业生涯都在非职业联赛中度过，他此前只能梦想与春天时险些输掉欧冠决赛的球队交手。
所有人都期待一场例行公事的胜利，尽管米克尔·阿尔特塔给了年轻人表现的机会。如果说阿尔特塔是想考验年轻人，那么马利·萨尔蒙的天真则被从富勒姆租借而来的卢帕洛-比暴露无遗。
本赛季他一直在第四级别联赛锻炼，并在对阵这名17岁后卫时将利用身体的技巧付诸实践，他转身并扛住防守球员，随后在伊兰·梅利耶脚下推射破门，第二次点燃了全场的气氛。
在此之前，比赛已经因一架无人机在球场上空飞行而延迟了六分钟。主裁判迈克尔·索尔兹伯里不得不将球员带到场边，而警察则在球场外搜寻罪魁祸首。对于这个成为菲尔德海岸非凡之夜的起点来说，这是一个不寻常的开局。比赛伴随着大量烟花开始，在球场上空制造了一层红色薄雾，坦白说，无论在字面意义还是象征意义上，这层薄雾从未消散。
上半场对阿森纳来说是一场苦战，他们无法创造出任何有威胁的进攻，不断被劳勒及其教练组组织严密的纪律防线所化解。面对一支乐于看他们走过场的球队，枪手们的表现显得十分沉闷。凯·哈弗茨错过了中场休息前扳平比分的绝佳机会，他的头球偏出，这也总结了他这场艰难的比赛。
下半场情况有所不同，马丁·厄德高替补登场，成为阿森纳的进攻指挥官，为球队创造了他们急需的节奏。他带来了凝聚力和强度，帮助球队重新回到了比赛中。

约克雷斯门前混战扳平比分，当时很少有人怀疑阿森纳会继续赢得比赛，但弗利特伍德坚守到了最后。
主队从一开始就采取直接的打法，接受自身的局限性，并深知主场条件会对他们有利。盘旋的风势将球滞留在空中，并让不习惯海风狂风的后卫们感到困惑。
弗利特伍德强硬的踢法激怒了阿森纳，多曼情绪失控，因对阵核心哈里森·尼尔做出反应而被红牌罚下。在萨尔蒙因失球暴露出问题后，他是第二个从顶级联赛之外的生活中吸取宝贵教训的枪手青少年。
在球队已经颇具挑战性的夜晚，多曼的举动或许有些严厉，但也确实显得不必要地急躁。米克尔·阿尔特塔在多曼离场时和他交谈了几句。阿尔特塔说了什么？“我们赛前就已经讨论过的事情。”
阿森纳随后通过本·怀特和约克雷斯获得了两次扳平比分的晚期机会，但在比赛时间超过90分钟后，林奇作出了两次精彩的扑救，确保比赛进入了戏剧性的终局，他也得以再次成为足球和弗利特伍德镇伟大之夜的英雄。
